===== ARCHIVO: bridge/src/telegram-client.ts =====
import { Api, TelegramClient } from "teleproto";
import { StringSession } from "teleproto/sessions";
import { Logger, LogLevel } from "teleproto/extensions/Logger.js";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { normalizePhone } from "../../lib/domain.ts";
import { BridgeError } from "./errors.ts";
import type { Message, Transport } from "./engine.ts";
export function incomingMessage(raw: Api.TypeMessage): Message | null {
  if (
    !(raw instanceof Api.Message) ||
    raw.out ||
    !(raw.peerId instanceof Api.PeerUser) ||
    raw.peerId.userId.toString() !== "6108968969" ||
    raw.fwdFrom ||
    raw.viaBotId ||
    (raw.fromId &&
      (!(raw.fromId instanceof Api.PeerUser) ||
        raw.fromId.userId.toString() !== "6108968969"))
  )
    return null;
  // Telegram may omit from_id in a private incoming message. The authenticated
  // peer, incoming flag and absence of forwarding identify the correspondent.
  return {
    id: raw.id,
    senderId: "6108968969",
    chatId: "6108968969",
    replyTo: raw.replyTo?.replyToMsgId,
    text: raw.message,
  };
}
export function applicationCredentials() {
  const apiId = Number(process.env.TELEGRAM_API_ID),
    apiHash = process.env.TELEGRAM_API_HASH ?? "";
  if (
    !Number.isSafeInteger(apiId) ||
    apiId < 1 ||
    !/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/i.test(apiHash)
  )
    throw new BridgeError("APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS", 503);
  return { apiId, apiHash };
}
export function makeClient(session: string, login = false) {
  const { apiId, apiHash } = applicationCredentials();
  return new TelegramClient(new StringSession(session), apiId, apiHash, {
    baseLogger: new Logger(LogLevel.NONE),
    requestRetries: login ? 3 : 1,
    floodSleepThreshold: 0,
    connectionRetries: 1,
    reconnectRetries: 1,
    autoReconnect: false,
    timeout: 5,
    deviceModel: "Notas Escena · servidor propio",
    appVersion: "0.1.0",
    securityChecks: true,
  });
}
export class UserTransport implements Transport {
  client: TelegramClient;
  peer: Api.InputPeerUser | null = null;
  constructor(client: TelegramClient) {
    this.client = client;
  }
  options(signal: AbortSignal, timeout = 3000): Api.ApiCallOptions {
    return {
      abortSignal: signal,
      timeout,
      maxRetryCount: 0,
      floodSleepThreshold: 0,
    };
  }
  async verify(signal: AbortSignal) {
    const [me] = await this.client.api.users.getUsers(
      { id: [new Api.InputUserSelf()] },
      this.options(signal),
    );
    const resolved = await this.client.api.contacts.resolveUsername(
      { username: "TrueCalleRobot" },
      this.options(signal),
    );
    const bot = resolved.users.find(
      (u) => u instanceof Api.User && u.id.toString() === "6108968969",
    );
    if (
      !(me instanceof Api.User) ||
      me.bot ||
      !me.phone ||
      !(bot instanceof Api.User) ||
      !bot.bot ||
      !bot.accessHash ||
      !(resolved.peer instanceof Api.PeerUser) ||
      resolved.peer.userId.toString() !== "6108968969"
    )
      throw new BridgeError("ACCOUNT_OR_TARGET", 503);
    this.peer = new Api.InputPeerUser({
      userId: bot.id,
      accessHash: bot.accessHash,
    });
    return {
      phone: normalizePhone("+" + me.phone),
      targetId: bot.id.toString(),
      targetBot: !!bot.bot,
      targetUsername: bot.username ?? "",
    };
  }
  async send(phone: string, signal: AbortSignal, requestId: string) {
    if (!this.peer) throw new BridgeError("TARGET", 503);
    const randomId = BigInt.asIntN(
      64,
      BigInt(
        "0x" +
          createHash("sha256").update(requestId).digest("hex").slice(0, 16),
      ),
    );
    const result = await this.client.api.messages.sendMessage(
      { peer: this.peer, message: phone, randomId, noWebpage: true },
      this.options(signal),
    );
    if (result instanceof Api.UpdateShortSentMessage) return result.id;
    if (
      result instanceof Api.Updates ||
      result instanceof Api.UpdatesCombined
    ) {
      const matching = result.updates.find(
        (u) =>
          u instanceof Api.UpdateMessageID &&
          u.randomId?.toString() === randomId.toString(),
      );
      if (matching instanceof Api.UpdateMessageID) return matching.id;
      const update = result.updates.find(
        (u) =>
          u instanceof Api.UpdateNewMessage &&
          u.message instanceof Api.Message &&
          u.message.out &&
          u.message.message === phone &&
          u.message.peerId instanceof Api.PeerUser &&
          u.message.peerId.userId.toString() === "6108968969",
      );
      if (
        update instanceof Api.UpdateNewMessage &&
        update.message instanceof Api.Message
      )
        return update.message.id;
    }
    throw new BridgeError("SEND_UNCONFIRMED");
  }
  async messages(sent: number, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<Message[]> {
    if (!this.peer) throw new BridgeError("TARGET", 503);
    const history = await this.client.api.messages.getHistory(
      {
        peer: this.peer,
        offsetId: 0,
        offsetDate: 0,
        addOffset: 0,
        limit: 20,
        maxId: 0,
        minId: sent,
        hash: 0n,
      },
      this.options(signal, 2000),
    );
    if (!("messages" in history)) return [];
    return history.messages
      .map(incomingMessage)
      .filter((m): m is Message => m !== null);
  }
}

===== ARCHIVO: bridge/src/vault.ts =====
import { createCipheriv, createDecipheriv, randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import {
  mkdirSync,
  chmodSync,
  readFileSync,
  writeFileSync,
  renameSync,
  lstatSync,
} from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { BridgeError } from "./errors.ts";
function key(value: string) {
  const bytes = Buffer.from(value, "base64");
  if (bytes.length !== 32) throw new BridgeError("VAULT_KEY", 503);
  return bytes;
}
export function seal(value: string, encodedKey: string): string {
  const iv = randomBytes(12),
    cipher = createCipheriv("aes-256-gcm", key(encodedKey), iv);
  const data = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(value, "utf8"), cipher.final()]);
  return JSON.stringify({
    v: 1,
    iv: iv.toString("base64"),
    tag: cipher.getAuthTag().toString("base64"),
    data: data.toString("base64"),
  });
}
export function unseal(value: string, encodedKey: string): string {
  try {
    const v = JSON.parse(value);
    if (
      v.v !== 1 ||
      typeof v.iv !== "string" ||
      typeof v.tag !== "string" ||
      typeof v.data !== "string" ||
      value.length > 20000
    )
      throw new Error();
    const decipher = createDecipheriv(
      "aes-256-gcm",
      key(encodedKey),
      Buffer.from(v.iv, "base64"),
    );
    decipher.setAuthTag(Buffer.from(v.tag, "base64"));
    return Buffer.concat([
      decipher.update(Buffer.from(v.data, "base64")),
      decipher.final(),
    ]).toString("utf8");
  } catch {
    throw new BridgeError("VAULT_INVALID", 503);
  }
}
export function stateDirectory() {
  const path = process.env.BRIDGE_STATE_DIR || ".bridge-state";
  mkdirSync(path, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
  if (lstatSync(path).isSymbolicLink())
    throw new BridgeError("STATE_PATH", 503);
  chmodSync(path, 0o700);
  return path;
}
export function saveSession(session: string, encodedKey: string) {
  const dir = stateDirectory(),
    temporary = join(dir, "session.new");
  writeFileSync(temporary, seal(session, encodedKey), {
    mode: 0o600,
    flag: "wx",
  });
  renameSync(temporary, join(dir, "session.enc"));
  chmodSync(join(dir, "session.enc"), 0o600);
}
export function loadSession(encodedKey: string) {
  const path = join(stateDirectory(), "session.enc");
  if (lstatSync(path).isSymbolicLink() || lstatSync(path).mode & 0o077)
    throw new BridgeError("SESSION_PERMISSIONS", 503);
  return unseal(readFileSync(path, "utf8"), encodedKey);
}

const phone = "+34600000001",
  target = "6108968969";
function setup(batches?: Message[][]) {
  let sends = 0,
    polls = 0;
  const transport: Transport = {
    verify: async () => ({
      phone,
      targetId: target,
      targetBot: true,
      targetUsername: "TrueCalleRobot",
    }),
    send: async () => {
      sends++;
      return 10;
    },
    messages: async () =>

import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { createServer } from "node:http";
import { createHandler } from "../src/http.ts";
import { validateResult } from "../../lib/domain.ts";
test("HTTP: autentica, tamaño/forma/clave idempotente, sin CORS, error seguro y contrato válido", async () => {
  let called = 0;
  const secret = "test-bearer-" + "x".repeat(40);
  const server = createServer(
    createHandler(
      {
        lookup: async (input) => {
          called++;
          return {
            requestId: input.requestId,
            phone: input.phone,
            final: true,
            found: true,
            name: "Persona ficticia",
          };
        },
      },
      secret,
    ),
  );
  await new Promise<void>((r) => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", r));
  const addr = server.address();
  if (!addr || typeof addr === "string") throw new Error();
  const url = `http://127.0.0.1:${addr.port}/lookup`;
  try {
    assert.equal((await fetch(url, { method: "POST" })).status, 401);
    const input = {
      requestId: crypto.randomUUID(),
      sessionId: crypto.randomUUID(),
      phone: "+34600000001",
    };
    const headers = {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${secret}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "Idempotency-Key": input.requestId,
    };
    assert.equal(
      (
        await fetch(url, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { ...headers, Origin: "https://untrusted.example" },
          body: JSON.stringify(input),
        })
      ).status,
      403,
    );
    assert.equal(
      (
        await fetch(url, {
          method: "POST",
          headers,
          body: JSON.stringify({ ...input, extra: true }),
        })
      ).status,
      400,
    );
    assert.equal(
      (await fetch(url, { method: "POST", headers, body: "x".repeat(2049) }))
        .status,
      413,
    );
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      method: "POST",
      headers,
      body: JSON.stringify(input),
    });
    assert.equal(response.status, 200);
    assert.equal(response.headers.get("access-control-allow-origin"), null);
    assert.equal(response.headers.get("cache-control"), "no-store");
    const result = validateResult(
      await response.json(),
      input.requestId,
      input.phone,
    );
    assert.equal(result.requestId, input.requestId);
    assert.equal(result.name, "Persona ficticia");
    assert.equal(called, 1);
  } finally {
    server.closeAllConnections();
    await new Promise<void>((r) => server.close(() => r()));
  }
});

    path = join(dir, "ledger.sqlite"),

    b = new Ledger(path, "test-salt");

    assert.throws(
      () => b.claim(crypto.randomUUID(), "+34600000001", "session"),
      /BUSY_OR_COOLDOWN/,
    );

        () => reopened.claim(id, "+34600000001", "session"),
        /DUPLICATE/,

        () => reopened.claim(id, "+34600000001", "changed"),
        /PAYLOAD_MISMATCH/,
      );
    } finally {
      reopened.close();
    }
  } finally {
    b.close();
    rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }

import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { LoginChallenge } from "../src/login-challenge.ts";

test("login: corrige el código inválido dentro del mismo intento y limita errores", async () => {
  const challenge = new LoginChallenge();
  let input = challenge.wait("code", 5);
  challenge.submit(challenge.id, "12 345");
  assert.equal(await input, "12345");
  challenge.recover({ errorMessage: "PHONE_CODE_INVALID" });
  input = challenge.wait("code", 5);
  assert.equal(challenge.error, "PHONE_CODE_INVALID");
  challenge.submit(challenge.id, "54321");
  assert.equal(await input, "54321");
  challenge.recover({ errorMessage: "PHONE_CODE_INVALID" });
  assert.throws(() =>
    challenge.recover({ errorMessage: "PHONE_CODE_INVALID" }),
  );
});

test("login: confirmación repetida o de otro desafío nunca se reutiliza", async () => {
  const c = new LoginChallenge();
  const code = c.wait("code", 5),
    oldId = c.id;
  assert.throws(() => c.submit(oldId, "bad"));
  assert.ok(c.pending);
  c.submit(oldId, "12345");
  await code;
  assert.throws(() => c.submit(oldId, "12345"));
  const password = c.wait("password");
  assert.throws(() => c.submit(oldId, "12345"));
  c.submit(c.id, " password with spaces ");
  assert.equal(await password, " password with spaces ");
});

    assert.throws(() => c.recover({ errorMessage: code }));
  const waiting = c.wait("code", 5);
  c.cancel();
  await assert.rejects(waiting, /LOGIN_TIMEOUT/);

import test from "node:test";

import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import { seal, unseal } from "../src/vault.ts";
test("sesión cifrada: no aparece en claro, clave equivocada y manipulación se rechazan", () => {
  const key = randomBytes(32).toString("base64");
  const secret = "SESSION-FICTICIA-NUNCA-REAL";
  const envelope = seal(secret, key);
  assert.equal(envelope.includes(secret), false);
  assert.equal(unseal(envelope, key), secret);

  const value = JSON.parse(envelope);
  value.data = Buffer.from("alterado").toString("base64");
  assert.throws(() => unseal(JSON.stringify(value), key));
  assert.throws(() => seal(secret, "clave-corta"));
});

===== ARCHIVO: build/connector-preview-plugin.mjs =====
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { access, readFile, rename, rm, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { setTimeout as delay } from "node:timers/promises";
import getRawBody from "raw-body";

const moduleId = "virtual:sites-connector-preview";
const resolvedId = `\0${moduleId}`;
const endpoint = "/__sites_connector_preview/invoke";
const contextEndpoint = "/__sites_connector_preview/context";
const unavailable = {
  status: "binding_unavailable",
  message:
    "Connected apps need an active agent preview session in this preview.",
};
const uncertain = {
  status: "upstream_error",
  message:
    "The app did not return a confirmed result. The action may have completed; check before trying again.",
};

// A development-only adapter. The shared project directory connects the preview
// process to its owning agent even when they use different network namespaces.
export function connectorPreview() {
  const bridgeToken = randomUUID();
  let root;
  let server;
  async function readSession() {
    const session = JSON.parse(
      await readFile(path.join(root, "session.json"), "utf8"),
    );
    if (
      !/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/.test(session.id) ||
      (session.expiresAt !== null && !(session.expiresAt > Date.now()))
    )
      throw new Error("Session ended");
    if (
      !Number.isInteger(session.timeoutMs) ||
      session.timeoutMs <= 0 ||
      session.timeoutMs > 2 ** 31 - 1
    )
      throw new Error("Invalid session deadline");
    return session;
  }
  return {
    name: "sites-connector-preview",
    apply: "serve",
    config(config) {
      return {
        server: {
          host: config.server?.host ?? "127.0.0.1",
          strictPort: true,
          fs: {
            deny: [
              ".env",
              ".env.*",
              "*.{crt,pem}",
              "**/.git/**",
              "**/.sites-runtime/**",
            ],
          },
          watch: { ignored: ["**/.sites-runtime/**"] },
        },
      };
    },
    configResolved(config) {
      root = path.join(config.root, ".sites-runtime", "connector-preview");
    },
    resolveId(id) {
      if (id === moduleId) return resolvedId;
    },
    load(id, options) {
      if (id !== resolvedId) return;
      if (
        this.environment?.name === "client" ||
        (!this.environment && !options?.ssr)
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          "Connected apps are only available in Site server routes.",
        );
      }
      // Auxiliary Workers load before Vite starts listening. strictPort keeps
      // this configured address stable when the server opens its socket.
      const url = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.config.server.port}${endpoint}`;
      const contextUrl = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.config.server.port}${contextEndpoint}`;
      return `export default { async getContext() {
        try {
          const response = await fetch(${JSON.stringify(contextUrl)}, {
            headers: { "X-Sites-Preview": ${JSON.stringify(bridgeToken)} }
          });
          return response.json();
        } catch { return { status: "upstream_error" }; }
      }, async invoke(connectorId, actionName, args) {
        const response = await fetch(${JSON.stringify(url)}, {
          method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Sites-Preview": ${JSON.stringify(bridgeToken)} },
          body: JSON.stringify({connectorId, actionName, arguments: args})
        });
        return response.json();
      } };`;
    },
    configureServer(vite) {
      server = vite;
      vite.middlewares.use(contextEndpoint, async (req, res) => {
        res.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");
        res.setHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");
        if (
          req.method !== "GET" ||
          req.headers["x-sites-preview"] !== bridgeToken
        ) {
          res.statusCode = 403;
          res.end(JSON.stringify(unavailable));
          return;
        }
        try {
          const session = await readSession();
          // Preview grants do not establish hosted catalog visibility.
          if (
            !Array.isArray(session.connectorIds) ||
            !session.connectorIds.every((id) => typeof id === "string")
          )
            throw new Error("Missing selected connectors");
          res.end(
            JSON.stringify({
              status: "success",
              connectors: session.connectorIds.map((connectorId) => ({
                connectorId,
                policy: "enabled",
                tools: null,
              })),
            }),
          );
        } catch {
          res.end(JSON.stringify({ status: "binding_unavailable" }));
        }
      });
      vite.middlewares.use(endpoint, async (req, res) => {
        res.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");
        res.setHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");
        if (
          req.method !== "POST" ||
          req.headers["x-sites-preview"] !== bridgeToken
        ) {
          res.statusCode = 403;
          res.end(JSON.stringify(unavailable));
          return;
        }
        let requestPath;
        let responsePath;
        let submitted = false;
        try {
          const session = await readSession();
          const raw = await getRawBody(req, { limit: 65536 });
          const call = JSON.parse(
            new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(raw),
          );
          const body = JSON.stringify(call);
          const directory = path.join(root, session.id);
          const id = randomUUID();
          requestPath = path.join(directory, `${id}.request`);
          responsePath = path.join(directory, `${id}.response`);
          await writeFile(`${requestPath}.tmp`, body, { mode: 0o600 });
          await rename(`${requestPath}.tmp`, requestPath);
          submitted = true;
          // Read the owner's deadline per call, so a restarted session can use
          // longer provider waits without rebuilding or restarting the Site.
          const deadline = Math.min(
            session.expiresAt ?? Infinity,
            Date.now() + session.timeoutMs + 2000,
          );
          while (Date.now() < deadline) {
            try {
              res.end(await readFile(responsePath));
              return;
            } catch (error) {
              if (error.code !== "ENOENT") throw error;
              // Session shutdown removes the mailbox. Stop promptly even when
              // the configured provider deadline is several minutes away.
              await access(directory);
            }
            await delay(50);
          }
          res.end(JSON.stringify(uncertain));
        } catch {
          // raw-body pauses oversized requests; drain the remainder so the HTTP
          // connection can finish without retaining an unread request stream.
          req.resume();
          res.end(JSON.stringify(submitted ? uncertain : unavailable));
        } finally {
          await Promise.all(
            [requestPath, requestPath && `${requestPath}.tmp`, responsePath]
              .filter(Boolean)
              .map((file) => rm(file, { force: true })),
          );
        }
      });
    },
  };
}

import { WorkerEntrypoint } from "cloudflare:workers";
import binding from "virtual:sites-connector-preview";

// Local-only RPC target. The Site entrypoint scopes it to each request; the Node
// adapter relays each call to the owning agent.
export class ConnectorPreview extends WorkerEntrypoint {
  async getContext() {
    return binding.getContext?.() ?? { status: "binding_unavailable" };
  }

  async invoke(connectorId, actionName, args) {
    return binding.invoke(connectorId, actionName, args);
  }
}

===== ARCHIVO: build/sites-vite-plugin.ts =====
// Vendored from @openai/sites-vite-plugin 0.2.0 (openai/sites#9).
// See sites-vite-plugin.LICENSE for the upstream MIT license.
import { access, cp, mkdir, rm } from "node:fs/promises";
import type { IncomingMessage, ServerResponse } from "node:http";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import type { Plugin } from "vite";

const localUserId = "local_seedy";
const localEmail = "seedy@sites.test";
const localFullName = "Seedy";
const localCookieName = "__sites_local_auth";
const localHosts = new Set(["localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"]);
const localAddresses = new Set(["127.0.0.1", "::1", "::ffff:127.0.0.1"]);
const authPaths = new Set([
  "/signin-with-chatgpt",
  "/signout-with-chatgpt",
  "/callback",
]);

async function exists(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await access(path);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") {
      return false;
    }
    throw error;
  }
}

export function sites({ mockAuth = true } = {}): Plugin {
  let root = process.cwd();
  let command: "build" | "serve" = "build";

  return {
    name: "sites",
    configResolved(config) {
      root = config.root;
      command = config.command;
    },
    configureServer(server) {
      if (!mockAuth) return;
      const secure = Boolean(server.config.server.https);

      server.config.logger.info(`Sites local sign-in: ${localEmail}`);
      server.middlewares.use((request, response, next) => {
        for (const name of Object.keys(request.headers)) {
          if (name.startsWith("oai-authenticated-user-")) {
            removeHeader(request, name);
          }
        }

        let authority: URL;
        let url: URL;
        try {
          authority = new URL(
            `${secure ? "https" : "http"}://${request.headers.host}`,
          );
          url = new URL(request.url ?? "/", authority);
        } catch {
          if (authPaths.has((request.url ?? "/").split("?")[0])) {
            respond(response, 403);
          } else {
            next();
          }
          return;
        }

        const hostname = authority.hostname
          .replace(/^\[|\]$/g, "")
          .toLowerCase();
        if (
          !localHosts.has(hostname) ||
          !localAddresses.has(request.socket.remoteAddress ?? "") ||
          url.origin !== authority.origin
        ) {
          if (authPaths.has(url.pathname)) respond(response, 403);
          else next();
          return;
        }

        const cookies = (request.headers.cookie ?? "")
          .split(";")
          .map((cookie) => cookie.trim())
          .filter(Boolean);
        const signInCookies = cookies
          .filter((cookie) => cookie.startsWith(`${localCookieName}=`))
          .map((cookie) => cookie.slice(localCookieName.length + 1));
        const applicationCookies = cookies.filter(
          (cookie) => !cookie.startsWith(`${localCookieName}=`),
        );
        if (applicationCookies.length !== cookies.length) {
          removeHeader(request, "cookie");
          if (applicationCookies.length) {
            setHeader(request, "cookie", applicationCookies.join("; "));
          }
        }

        if (url.pathname === "/callback") {
          respond(response, 501);
          return;
        }

        const signIn = url.pathname === "/signin-with-chatgpt";
        const signOut = url.pathname === "/signout-with-chatgpt";
        if (!signIn && !signOut) {
          if (signInCookies.length === 1 && signInCookies[0] === "1") {
            setHeader(request, "oai-authenticated-user-id", localUserId);
            setHeader(request, "oai-authenticated-user-email", localEmail);
            setHeader(
              request,
              "oai-authenticated-user-full-name",
              localFullName,
            );
            setHeader(
              request,
              "oai-authenticated-user-full-name-encoding",
              "percent-encoded-utf-8",
            );
          }
          next();
          return;
        }

        if (
          (request.headers.origin && request.headers.origin !== url.origin) ||
          request.headers["sec-fetch-site"] === "cross-site"
        ) {
          respond(response, 403);
          return;
        }

        if (
          request.headers["next-router-prefetch"] !== undefined ||
          request.headers["x-middleware-prefetch"] === "1" ||
          [request.headers.purpose, request.headers["sec-purpose"]].some(
            (value) =>
              typeof value === "string" &&
              value
                .split(/[;,]/)
                .some((part) => part.trim().toLowerCase() === "prefetch"),
          )
        ) {
          respond(response, 204);
          return;
        }

        if (
          request.method !== "GET" &&
          (!signOut || request.method !== "POST")
        ) {
          response.setHeader("Allow", signIn ? "GET" : "GET, POST");
          respond(response, 405);
          return;
        }

        response.statusCode = request.method === "POST" ? 303 : 302;
        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "private, no-store");
        response.setHeader(
          "Location",
          safeReturn(url.searchParams.get("return_to")),
        );
        response.setHeader(
          "Set-Cookie",
          `${localCookieName}=${signIn ? "1" : ""}; Path=/; ${
            signOut ? "Max-Age=0; " : ""
          }HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax${secure ? "; Secure" : ""}`,
        );
        response.end();
      });
    },
    async closeBundle() {
      if (command !== "build") return;

      const outputDirectory = resolve(root, "dist", ".openai");
      const hostingConfig = resolve(root, ".openai", "hosting.json");
      const drizzleSource = resolve(root, "drizzle");

      await rm(outputDirectory, { recursive: true, force: true });
      await mkdir(outputDirectory, { recursive: true });

      await cp(hostingConfig, resolve(outputDirectory, "hosting.json"));
      if (await exists(drizzleSource)) {
        await cp(drizzleSource, resolve(outputDirectory, "drizzle"), {
          recursive: true,
        });
      }
    },
  };
}

function removeHeader(request: IncomingMessage, name: string): void {
  delete request.headers[name];
  for (let index = request.rawHeaders.length - 2; index >= 0; index -= 2) {
    if (request.rawHeaders[index]?.toLowerCase() === name) {
      request.rawHeaders.splice(index, 2);
    }
  }
}

function setHeader(
  request: IncomingMessage,
  name: string,
  value: string,
): void {
  removeHeader(request, name);
  request.headers[name] = value;
  request.rawHeaders.push(name, value);
}

function respond(response: ServerResponse, status: number): void {
  response.statusCode = status;
  response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "private, no-store");
  response.end();
}

function safeReturn(value: string | null): string {
  if (!value?.startsWith("/") || value.startsWith("//")) return "/";

  try {
    const url = new URL(value, "http://localhost");
    if (url.origin !== "http://localhost" || authPaths.has(url.pathname)) {
      return "/";
    }
    return `${url.pathname}${url.search}${url.hash}`;
  } catch {
    return "/";
  }
}

===== ARCHIVO: build/sites-worker.ts =====
import handler from "vinext/server/fetch-handler";
import { runWithConnectorBinding } from "../lib/connector-context";
import type { ConnectorBinding } from "../lib/connector-contract.mjs";

export default {
  fetch(request: Request, env: Cloudflare.Env, ctx: ExecutionContext<{ CONNECTORS?: ConnectorBinding }>) {
    let binding = ctx.props?.CONNECTORS;
    // Local preview emulates the same request-scoped capability. This branch and
    // the auxiliary service binding are absent from production builds.
    if (import.meta.env.DEV && !binding && env.CONNECTORS) {
      const preview = env.CONNECTORS;
      const expiresAt = Date.now() + 60_000;
      binding = {
        async getContext() {
          if (Date.now() >= expiresAt) return { status: "request_context_expired" };
          return preview.getContext?.() ?? { status: "binding_unavailable" };
        },
        async invoke(connectorId, actionName, args) {
          if (Date.now() >= expiresAt) {
            return { status: "request_context_expired", message: "This request has expired. Please try again." };
          }
          return preview.invoke(connectorId, actionName, args);
        },
      };
    }
    return runWithConnectorBinding(binding, () => handler.fetch(request, env, ctx));
  },
};

import { APP_VERSION } from "../lib/client/version";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { api, type Config, type Session } from "../lib/client/api";
import { Icon } from "./Icon";
type Diagnostic = {
  id: string;
  status: string;
  code: string | null;
  provider_ms: number | null;
};
export function Artist({
  config,
  session,
  status,
  detail,
  metrics,
  close,
  start,
  erase,
}: {
  config: Config | null;
  session: Session | null;
  status: string;
  detail: string;
  metrics: { ui: number; provider: number | null } | null;
  close: () => void;
  start: (ids: string[]) => Promise<void>;
  erase: () => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [ids, setIds] = useState<string[]>(
      config?.participants.map((p) => p.id) ?? [],
    ),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [connectionMessage, setConnectionMessage] = useState(""),
    [logs, setLogs] = useState<Diagnostic[]>([]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (session)
      api<Diagnostic[]>(
        `diagnostics?sessionId=${session.id}`,
        undefined,
        session.csrf,
      )
        .then(setLogs)
        .catch((e) => setError(e.message));
  }, [session]);
  async function action(fn: () => Promise<void>) {
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await fn();
    } catch (e) {
      setError((e as Error).message);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <section className="artist-screen">
      <header className="plain-header">
        <button className="round" aria-label="Volver a Notas" onClick={close}>
          <Icon name="back" />
        </button>
        <h1>Área del artista</h1>
      </header>
      <div className="artist-content">
        <div className="mode-label">
          {config?.mode === "real"
            ? config.transport === "telegram"
              ? "Telegram · bot propio"
              : "Proveedor real"
            : "Demostración · datos ficticios"}
        </div>
        <h2>Prepara la sesión</h2>
        <p>
          Solo se consultan las fichas autorizadas que selecciones aquí. Entrega
          el dispositivo al participante cuando la sesión esté preparada.
        </p>
        <p className="small">
          Al detectar un único móvil autorizado, la consulta comienza después de
          una pausa de 800 ms. Mantén pulsados los eslabones para ver la
          respuesta; se oculta al soltar y la nota conserva su texto. No se
          reintenta automáticamente.
        </p>
        {!config && <p role="status">Cargando configuración…</p>}
        {config?.mode === "real" && config.transport === "telegram" && (
          <div className="notice">
            <p>
              La configuración no demuestra que el destinatario admita la
              conexión. La comprobación no envía teléfonos ni inicia consultas.
            </p>
            <button
              className="primary light"
              disabled={busy || !config.realConfigured}
              onClick={() =>
                action(async () => {
                  await api("provider-check");
                  setConnectionMessage(
                    "Token y conversación comprobados. Comunicación entre bots y protocolo todavía pendientes de una consulta autorizada real.",
                  );
                })
              }
            >
              Comprobar conexión del bot
            </button>
            {connectionMessage && <p role="status">{connectionMessage}</p>}
          </div>
        )}
        {config && (
          <>
            <p className="small">Artista: {config.artist}</p>
            {config.mode === "demo" ? (
              <p className="notice">
                Este modo no envía nada a Telegram. Los números siguientes son
                claves sintéticas del juego y sus fichas están inventadas.
              </p>
            ) : (
              <p className="notice">
                Solo aparecen altas con evidencia previa de consentimiento y
                titularidad en el registro del servidor. La respuesta del
                proveedor no acredita una identidad verificada.
              </p>
            )}
            <fieldset>
              <legend>Participantes de esta sesión</legend>
              {config.participants.map((p) => (
                <label className="participant" key={p.id}>
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={ids.includes(p.id)}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setIds(
                        e.target.checked
                          ? [...ids, p.id]
                          : ids.filter((i) => i !== p.id),
                      )
                    }
                  />
                  <span>
                    {p.label}
                    <strong>{p.phone}</strong>
                  </span>
                </label>
              ))}
              {!config.participants.length && (
                <p>No hay participantes autorizados vigentes.</p>
              )}
            </fieldset>
            <button
              className="primary"
              disabled={
                busy ||
                !ids.length ||
                (config.mode === "real" && !config.realConfigured)
              }
              onClick={() => action(() => start(ids))}
            >
              {session ? "Reiniciar sesión" : "Preparar sesión"}
            </button>
          </>
        )}
        {session && (
          <>
            <div className="session-info">
              <h2>Sesión preparada</h2>
              <p>
                Caduca a las{" "}
                {new Intl.DateTimeFormat("es", {
                  hour: "2-digit",
                  minute: "2-digit",
                  timeZone: "Europe/Andorra",
                }).format(session.expires)}
                . Las notas de actuación no se guardan en este dispositivo.
              </p>
              <button className="primary light" onClick={close}>
                Volver a las notas
              </button>
            </div>
            <button
              className="danger"
              disabled={busy}
              onClick={() => action(erase)}
            >
              Borrar sesión y resultados
            </button>
          </>
        )}
        <div className="diagnostics">
          <h2>Estado y diagnóstico</h2>
          <p className="small">Versión {APP_VERSION}</p>
          <p>
            <strong>{status}</strong>
          </p>
          <p className="small">
            {detail ||
              "La consulta empieza con un móvil autorizado. Mantén pulsados los eslabones para ver el peek; suelta para ocultarlo. Tras un error, volver a mantenerlos inicia un reintento explícito."}
          </p>
          {metrics && (
            <p className="small">
              Respuesta visual: {metrics.ui.toFixed(1)} ms · Proveedor:{" "}
              {metrics.provider === null
                ? "pendiente"
                : `${metrics.provider} ms`}
            </p>
          )}
          {logs.map((l) => (
            <p className="small" key={l.id}>
              {l.status}
              {l.code ? ` · ${l.code}` : ""}
              {l.provider_ms !== null ? ` · ${l.provider_ms} ms` : ""}
              <br />
              <span className="request-id">{l.id}</span>
            </p>
          ))}
        </div>
        {error && (
          <p className="error" role="alert">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
        <div className="help">
          <h2>Uso en iPhone</h2>
          <p>
            Abre esta dirección en Safari y elige Compartir → Añadir a la
            pantalla de inicio. El teclado es el del sistema. La consulta
            requiere mantener la app abierta y conexión a internet.
          </p>
          <p>
            El peek puede verlo quien mire la pantalla mientras mantienes
            pulsado. Se oculta al soltar. Deshacer permite descartar el
            resultado reservado.
          </p>
          <p>
            No se almacenan resultados en la PWA, analítica ni cachés. Borrar
            aquí no borra lo que pueda conservar Telegram o el proveedor;
            solicita su eliminación según su política.
          </p>
          <p>
            La barra ofrece texto, lista, tabla de texto y adjuntar texto. El
            lápiz abre las opciones de escritura. Dibujo, escaneo, bloqueo
            nativo y edición colaborativa no están implementados.
          </p>
          <p className="small">
            Tu identificación del artista en este sitio:{" "}
            <span className="request-id">{config?.artistId}</span>
          </p>
        </div>
        <a className="signout" href="/signout-with-chatgpt?return_to=/">
          Cerrar sesión de artista
        </a>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

===== ARCHIVO: components/Editor.tsx =====
import {
  forwardRef,
  useEffect,
  useImperativeHandle,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type PointerEvent,
  type MouseEvent,
} from "react";
import { Icon, type IconName } from "./Icon";
import type { Note } from "../lib/client/notes";
import { EditorHistory, type Snapshot } from "../lib/client/editor-history";
type EditorSnapshot = Snapshot & {
  fragment?: DocumentFragment;
  anchor?: number[];
  focus?: number[];
  anchorOffset?: number;
  focusOffset?: number;
};
export type EditorHandle = {
  append: (text: string) => string;
  insert: (text: string) => void;
  replace: (text: string) => void;
  undo: () => void;
};
export const Editor = forwardRef<
  EditorHandle,
  {
    note: Note;
    change: (text: string) => void;
    back: () => void;
    beginPeek: () => void;
    endPeek: () => void;
    peek: string | null;
    status: string;
    pending: boolean;
    undoResult: () => boolean;
    remove: () => void;
    pin: () => void;
    artist: () => void;
  }
>((props, ref) => {
  const editor = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null),
    upload = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const initialText = useRef(props.note.text);
  const [menu, setMenu] = useState(false),
    [format, setFormat] = useState(false),
    [hint, setHint] = useState("");
  const [peekTop, setPeekTop] = useState(0);
  const peekPointer = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const history = useRef(
    new EditorHistory<EditorSnapshot>({
      text: props.note.text,
      start: 0,
      end: 0,
    }),
  );
  const before = useRef<EditorSnapshot | null>(null);
  const undoRef = useRef<() => void>(() => {});
  const redoRef = useRef<() => void>(() => {});
  const touch = useRef<{ target: EventTarget; x: number; y: number } | null>(
    null,
  );
  const lastTouch = useRef<{ target: EventTarget; at: number } | null>(null);
  function suppressRetargetedTouchClick(x: number, y: number) {
    // A touch-generated click can be retargeted to the list after deletion
    // removes its button. Consume that click, never a new pointer gesture.
    const clear = () => {
      window.removeEventListener("click", consume, true);
      window.removeEventListener("pointerdown", clear, true);
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
    const consume = (event: globalThis.MouseEvent) => {
      if (
        event.detail === 0 ||
        Math.hypot(event.clientX - x, event.clientY - y) > 24
      )
        return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      clear();
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(clear, 600);
    window.addEventListener("click", consume, true);
    window.addEventListener("pointerdown", clear, {
      capture: true,
      once: true,
    });
  }
  function focusAction(action: () => void, removesTarget = false) {
    return {
      onPointerDown(e: PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) {
        // Safari can suppress click after cancelling touch pointerdown. Handle
        // that activation on pointerup while preserving the native editor focus.
        e.preventDefault();
        touch.current =
          e.pointerType === "touch"
            ? { target: e.currentTarget, x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY }
            : null;
      },
      onPointerUp(e: PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) {
        const start = touch.current;
        touch.current = null;
        if (
          e.pointerType !== "touch" ||
          !start ||
          start.target !== e.currentTarget ||
          Math.hypot(start.x - e.clientX, start.y - e.clientY) > 10
        )
          return;
        e.preventDefault();
        lastTouch.current = { target: e.currentTarget, at: Date.now() };
        if (removesTarget) suppressRetargetedTouchClick(e.clientX, e.clientY);
        action();
      },
      onPointerCancel() {
        touch.current = null;
      },
      onClick(e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) {
        if (
          lastTouch.current?.target === e.currentTarget &&
          Date.now() - lastTouch.current.at < 500
        )
          return;
        action();
      },
    };
  }
  function capture(): EditorSnapshot {
    const el = editor.current;
    if (!el) return history.current.current;
    const selection = window.getSelection();
    const path = (node: Node | null) => {
      const indices: number[] = [];
      while (node && node !== el) {
        const parent = node.parentNode;
        if (!parent) return undefined;
        indices.unshift(Array.prototype.indexOf.call(parent.childNodes, node));
        node = parent;
      }
      return node === el ? indices : undefined;
    };
    const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
    for (const node of el.childNodes) fragment.append(node.cloneNode(true));
    return {
      text: el.innerText,
      start: 0,
      end: 0,
      fragment,
      anchor: path(selection?.anchorNode ?? null),
      focus: path(selection?.focusNode ?? null),
      anchorOffset: selection?.anchorOffset,
      focusOffset: selection?.focusOffset,
    };
  }
  function restore(snapshot: EditorSnapshot) {
    const el = editor.current;
    if (!el) return;
    if (snapshot.fragment)
      el.replaceChildren(snapshot.fragment.cloneNode(true));
    else el.textContent = snapshot.text;
    el.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    const locate = (path?: number[]) => {
      let node: Node = el;
      for (const index of path ?? []) {
        if (!node.childNodes[index]) return null;
        node = node.childNodes[index];
      }
      return node;
    };
    const anchor = locate(snapshot.anchor),
      focus = locate(snapshot.focus),
      selection = window.getSelection();
    if (anchor && focus && snapshot.anchor && snapshot.focus) {
      try {
        selection?.setBaseAndExtent(
          anchor,
          snapshot.anchorOffset ?? 0,
          focus,
          snapshot.focusOffset ?? 0,
        );
      } catch {}
    } else {
      const range = document.createRange();
      range.selectNodeContents(el);
      range.collapse(false);
      selection?.removeAllRanges();
      selection?.addRange(range);
    }
    before.current = null;
    props.change(snapshot.text);
  }
  function notify() {
    const snapshot = capture();
    if (snapshot.text.length > 20000) {
      restore(before.current ?? history.current.current);
      before.current = null;
      setHint(
        "La nota admite hasta 20.000 caracteres. No se añadió el texto excedente.",
      );
      return;
    }
    history.current.record(snapshot, before.current ?? undefined);
    before.current = null;
    props.change(snapshot.text);
  }

  function insert(text: string, append = false) {
    const el = editor.current;
    if (!el) return;
    before.current = capture();
    const scrollTop = document.scrollingElement?.scrollTop ?? 0;
    const selection = window.getSelection();
    const previous = selection?.rangeCount
      ? selection.getRangeAt(0).cloneRange()
      : null;
    el.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    if (
      append ||
      !selection?.anchorNode ||
      !el.contains(selection.anchorNode)
    ) {
      const range = document.createRange();
      range.selectNodeContents(el);
      range.collapse(false);
      selection?.removeAllRanges();
      selection?.addRange(range);
    }
    if (!document.execCommand("insertText", false, text)) {
      const range = selection?.getRangeAt(0);
      if (range) {
        range.deleteContents();
        const node = document.createTextNode(text);
        range.insertNode(node);
        range.setStartAfter(node);
        range.collapse(true);
        selection?.removeAllRanges();
        selection?.addRange(range);
      }
      notify();
    }
    if (append && previous && el.contains(previous.startContainer)) {
      selection?.removeAllRanges();
      selection?.addRange(previous);
    }
    if (document.scrollingElement)
      document.scrollingElement.scrollTop = scrollTop;
  }
  function replace(text: string) {
    const el = editor.current;
    if (!el) return;
    el.textContent = text;
    // Removing a provider result must also discard its undo snapshots.
    history.current = new EditorHistory(capture());
    before.current = null;
    restore(history.current.current);
  }
  function undo() {
    if (!props.undoResult()) {
      const snapshot = history.current.undo();
      if (snapshot) restore(snapshot);
    }
  }
  function redo() {
    const snapshot = history.current.redo();
    if (snapshot) restore(snapshot);
  }
  undoRef.current = undo;
  redoRef.current = redo;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!props.peek || !editor.current) return;
    const el = editor.current;
    const range = document.createRange();
    range.selectNodeContents(el);
    const position = () =>
      setPeekTop(
        range.getBoundingClientRect().bottom -
          el.getBoundingClientRect().top +
          18,
      );
    position();
    window.addEventListener("resize", position);
    window.visualViewport?.addEventListener("resize", position);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("resize", position);
      window.visualViewport?.removeEventListener("resize", position);
    };
  }, [props.peek]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = editor.current;
    if (!el) return;
    function beforeInput(e: Event) {
      const input = e as InputEvent;
      if (input.inputType === "historyUndo" && input.cancelable) {
        input.preventDefault();
        undoRef.current();
      } else if (input.inputType === "historyRedo" && input.cancelable) {
        input.preventDefault();
        redoRef.current();
      } else before.current = capture();
    }
    el.addEventListener("beforeinput", beforeInput);
    return () => el.removeEventListener("beforeinput", beforeInput);
  }, []);
  useImperativeHandle(ref, () => ({
    append: (text) => {
      insert(text, true);
      return editor.current?.innerText ?? props.note.text;
    },
    insert: (text) => insert(text),
    replace,
    undo,
  }));
  useEffect(() => {
    if (editor.current) {
      editor.current.textContent = initialText.current;
      history.current = new EditorHistory(capture());
      if (!initialText.current) editor.current.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!menu && !format) return;
    const escape = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        setMenu(false);
        setFormat(false);
        editor.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      }
    };
    const outside = (e: globalThis.PointerEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as Element;
      if (
        !target.closest(
          ".note-menu,.format-menu,[aria-label='Opciones de nota'],[aria-label='Opciones de texto'],[aria-label='Opciones de escritura']",
        )
      ) {
        setMenu(false);
        setFormat(false);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", escape);
    window.addEventListener("pointerdown", outside);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", escape);
      window.removeEventListener("pointerdown", outside);
    };
  }, [menu, format]);
  const tool = (name: IconName, label: string, fn: () => void) => (
    <button className="tool" aria-label={label} {...focusAction(fn)}>
      <Icon name={name} />
    </button>
  );
  return (
    <section className="editor-screen">
      <header className="editor-header">
        <button
          className="round"
          aria-label="Volver a las notas"
          onClick={props.back}
        >
          <Icon name="back" />
        </button>
        <div className="editor-actions">
          <button
            className="round"
            aria-label="Deshacer"
            {...focusAction(undo)}
          >
            <Icon name="undo" />
          </button>
          <div className="action-pill">
            <button
              aria-label="Compartir nota"
              onClick={async () => {
                try {
                  if (navigator.share) {
                    await navigator.share({ text: props.note.text });
                  } else {
                    setHint(
                      "Compartir requiere Safari o un navegador con el menú de compartir.",
                    );
                  }
                } catch {
                  setHint("No se compartió la nota.");
                }
              }}
            >
              <Icon name="share" />
            </button>
            <button
              aria-label="Opciones de nota"
              aria-expanded={menu}
              onClick={() => setMenu(!menu)}
            >
              <Icon name="more" />
            </button>
          </div>
          <button
            className="round done"
            aria-label="Finalizar escritura"
            onClick={() => editor.current?.blur()}
          >
            <Icon name="check" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>
      {menu && (
        <div className="note-menu" role="group" aria-label="Acciones de nota">
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              props.pin();
              setMenu(false);
            }}
          >
            <Icon name="pin" />
            {props.note.pinned ? "Desfijar nota" : "Fijar nota"}
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              undo();
              setMenu(false);
            }}
          >
            <Icon name="undo" />
            Deshacer
          </button>
          <button onClick={props.artist}>Área del artista</button>
          <button className="danger" {...focusAction(props.remove, true)}>
            <Icon name="trash" />
            Eliminar nota
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="writing-stack">
        <div
          ref={editor}
          className="writing-area"
          contentEditable="plaintext-only"
          role="textbox"
          aria-label="Texto de la nota"
          aria-multiline="true"
          suppressContentEditableWarning
          spellCheck={false}
          autoCapitalize="sentences"
          onInput={notify}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "z") {
              e.preventDefault();
              if (e.shiftKey) redo();
              else undo();
            }
          }}
          onPaste={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            insert(e.clipboardData.getData("text/plain"));
          }}
        />
        {props.peek && (
          <div
            className="peek-result"
            role="status"
            aria-label="Vista temporal"
            style={{ top: peekTop }}
          >
            {props.peek.trimStart()}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      {hint && (
        <div className="editor-hint" role="status">
          <p>{hint}</p>
          <button onClick={() => setHint("")}>Cerrar</button>
        </div>
      )}
      {format && (
        <div className="format-menu">
          <p>Escritura</p>
          <button
            {...focusAction(() => {
              insert("• ");
              setFormat(false);
            })}
          >
            Añadir viñeta
          </button>
          <button
            {...focusAction(() => {
              insert("\n");
              setFormat(false);
            })}
          >
            Nueva línea
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              setFormat(false);
              setHint(
                "La primera línea es el título. El resto de la nota utiliza texto plano.",
              );
            }}
          >
            Formato de esta nota
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      <div
        className="keyboard-toolbar"
        role="toolbar"
        aria-label="Herramientas de escritura"
      >
        <button
          className="tool text-tool"
          aria-label="Opciones de texto"
          {...focusAction(() => setFormat(!format))}
        >
          Aa
        </button>
        {tool("checklist", "Añadir elemento de lista", () => insert("☐ "))}
        {tool("table", "Insertar tabla de texto", () =>
          insert("\nColumna A | Columna B\n────────── | ──────────\n"),
        )}
        {tool("clip", "Adjuntar archivo de texto", () =>
          upload.current?.click(),
        )}
        {tool("pen", "Opciones de escritura", () => setFormat(!format))}
        <button
          className={`tool link-tool ${["recibido", "completado"].includes(props.status) ? "complete" : ""} ${props.pending ? "pending" : ""} ${["error", "tiempo agotado", "sin resultado"].includes(props.status) ? "failed" : ""}`}
          aria-label={`Eslabones: ${props.status}`}
          aria-busy={props.pending}
          aria-pressed={!!props.peek}
          onPointerDown={(e) => {
            if (!e.isPrimary || e.button !== 0) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            peekPointer.current = e.pointerId;
            try {
              e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
            } catch {
              /* Global release handler remains active. */
            }
            props.beginPeek();
          }}
          onPointerUp={(e) => {
            if (peekPointer.current !== e.pointerId) return;
            peekPointer.current = null;
            props.endPeek();
            if (e.currentTarget.hasPointerCapture(e.pointerId))
              e.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
          }}
          onPointerCancel={() => {
            peekPointer.current = null;
            props.endPeek();
          }}
          onLostPointerCapture={() => {
            peekPointer.current = null;
            props.endPeek();
          }}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (![" ", "Enter"].includes(e.key) || e.repeat) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            props.beginPeek();
          }}
          onKeyUp={(e) => {
            if ([" ", "Enter"].includes(e.key)) {
              e.preventDefault();
              props.endPeek();
            }
          }}
          onBlur={props.endPeek}
          onContextMenu={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
          onClick={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
        >
          <Icon name="link" />
          <span className="state-mark" aria-hidden="true" />
        </button>
      </div>
      <input
        ref={upload}
        type="file"
        accept="text/plain,.txt"
        className="sr-only"
        aria-label="Archivo de texto"
        onChange={async (e) => {
          const f = e.target.files?.[0];
          if (f) {
            if (f.size > 10000) {
              setHint("El archivo de texto debe ocupar menos de 10 KB.");
            } else {
              insert("\n" + (await f.text()));
            }
          }
          e.target.value = "";
        }}
      />
      <span className="sr-only" role="status" aria-live="polite">
        {props.status}
      </span>
    </section>
  );
});
Editor.displayName = "Editor";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  dateLabel,
  excerpt,
  findNotes,
  groups,
  title,
  type Note,
} from "../lib/client/notes";
import { Icon } from "./Icon";
export function NoteList({
  notes,
  open,
  create,
  artist,
  folders,
  search,
  setSearch,
  folded,
  setFolded,
  remove,
  pin,
}: {
  notes: Note[];
  open: (id: string) => void;
  create: () => void;
  artist: () => void;
  folders: () => void;
  search: string;
  setSearch: (value: string) => void;
  folded: boolean;
  setFolded: (value: boolean) => void;
  remove: (id: string) => void;
  pin: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  const [, refreshDates] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const refresh = () => refreshDates((n) => n + 1);
    const timer = setInterval(refresh, 60000);
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", refresh);
    return () => {
      clearInterval(timer);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", refresh);
    };
  }, []);
  const found = findNotes(notes, search);
  return (
    <section className="list-screen">
      <header className="list-header">
        <button className="round" aria-label="Carpetas" onClick={folders}>
          <Icon name="back" />
        </button>
        <div className="list-heading">
          <h1>Notas</h1>
          <p>
            {notes.length} {notes.length === 1 ? "nota" : "notas"}
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          className="round"
          aria-label="Menú y área del artista"
          onClick={artist}
        >
          <Icon name="more" />
        </button>
      </header>
      <div className="note-groups">
        {groups(found).map(([label, items]) => (
          <section className="note-section" key={label}>
            <div className="section-heading">
              <h2>{label}</h2>
              {label === "Fijadas" && (
                <button
                  aria-label={folded ? "Mostrar fijadas" : "Ocultar fijadas"}
                  aria-expanded={!folded}
                  className={`collapse ${folded ? "folded" : ""}`}
                  onClick={() => setFolded(!folded)}
                >
                  <Icon name="chevron" />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
            {!(label === "Fijadas" && folded) && (
              <div className="note-card">
                {items.map((n) => (
                  <NoteRow
                    key={n.id}
                    note={n}
                    open={() => open(n.id)}
                    remove={() => remove(n.id)}
                    pin={() => pin(n.id)}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </section>
        ))}
        {!found.length && (
          <p className="empty">
            {search ? "No se encontraron notas." : "Todavía no hay notas."}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
      <footer className="list-bottom">
        <label className="search-pill">
          <Icon name="search" />
          <input
            type="search"
            placeholder="Buscar"
            aria-label="Buscar notas"
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
          />
          {search && (
            <button aria-label="Limpiar búsqueda" onClick={() => setSearch("")}>
              <Icon name="close" />
            </button>
          )}
        </label>
        <button
          className="round compose"
          aria-label="Crear nueva nota"
          onClick={create}
        >
          <Icon name="compose" />
        </button>
      </footer>
    </section>
  );
}

function NoteRow({
  note,
  open,
  remove,
  pin,
}: {
  note: Note;
  open: () => void;
  remove: () => void;
  pin: () => void;
}) {
  const [action, setAction] = useState<"pin" | "delete" | null>(null);
  const start = useRef<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);
  const dragged = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!action) return;
    const close = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") setAction(null);
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", close);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", close);
  }, [action]);
  return (
    <div className={`swipe-row ${action ? `show-${action}` : ""}`}>
      {action && (
        <button
          className={`swipe-action ${action === "delete" ? "danger" : ""}`}
          aria-label={
            action === "delete"
              ? `Eliminar ${title(note)}`
              : `${note.pinned ? "Desfijar" : "Fijar"} ${title(note)}`
          }
          onClick={() => {
            (action === "delete" ? remove : pin)();
            setAction(null);
          }}
        >
          <Icon name={action === "delete" ? "trash" : "pin"} />
          <span>
            {action === "delete"
              ? "Eliminar"
              : note.pinned
                ? "Desfijar"
                : "Fijar"}
          </span>
        </button>
      )}
      <button
        className="note-row"
        aria-expanded={!!action}
        onPointerDown={(e) => {
          start.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
          dragged.current = false;
        }}
        onPointerMove={(e) => {
          const p = start.current;
          if (!p) return;
          const dx = e.clientX - p.x,
            dy = e.clientY - p.y;
          if (Math.abs(dy) > 24 && Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx)) {
            start.current = null;
            return;
          }
          if (Math.abs(dx) > 45 && Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy) * 1.5) {
            dragged.current = true;
            setAction(dx < 0 ? "delete" : "pin");
          }
        }}
        onPointerUp={() => {
          start.current = null;
        }}
        onPointerCancel={() => {
          start.current = null;
        }}
        onContextMenu={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          setAction(action ? null : "delete");
        }}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === "Delete") {
            e.preventDefault();
            setAction("delete");
          }
          if (e.key === "ArrowRight") {
            e.preventDefault();
            setAction("pin");
          }
        }}
        onClick={() => {
          if (dragged.current) return;
          if (action) setAction(null);
          else open();
        }}
      >
        <span className="row-title">{title(note)}</span>
        <span className="row-excerpt">
          <time>{dateLabel(note.updated)}</time> {excerpt(note)}
        </span>
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
