import { test, expect } from "playwright/test";
import AxeBuilder from "@axe-core/playwright";
import { prepare, fixtures, key } from "./fixtures";

test("U01: listado, editor, opciones, artista y carpetas sin infracciones automáticas WCAG A/AA", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await prepare(page);
  const check = async () => {
    const result = await new AxeBuilder({ page })
      .withTags(["wcag2a", "wcag2aa", "wcag21a", "wcag21aa", "wcag22aa"])
      .analyze();
    expect(
      result.violations.map((v) => ({
        id: v.id,
        nodes: v.nodes.map((n) => n.target),
      })),
    ).toEqual([]);
  };
  await check();
  await page.locator(".note-row").first().click();
  await check();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Opciones de nota" }).click();
  await check();
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Área del artista", exact: true })
    .click();
  await check();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Volver" }).click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Volver a las notas" }).click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Carpetas", exact: true }).click();
  await check();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: /Eliminadas recientemente/ }).click();
  await check();
});
test("U02: deslizar fija y elimina sin abrir la nota; recuperar y cancelación de borrado definitivo", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await prepare(page);
  const row = page.locator(".note-row").filter({ hasText: "Ensayo 6" });
  const box = (await row.boundingBox())!;
  await row.dispatchEvent("pointerdown", {
    pointerId: 1,
    pointerType: "touch",
    clientX: box.x + 20,
    clientY: box.y + 20,
  });
  await row.dispatchEvent("pointermove", {
    pointerId: 1,
    pointerType: "touch",
    clientX: box.x + 90,
    clientY: box.y + 20,
  });
  await row.dispatchEvent("pointerup", { pointerId: 1, pointerType: "touch" });
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Fijar Ensayo 6", exact: true })
    .click();
  await expect(page.locator(".note-section").first()).toContainText("Ensayo 6");
  await row.focus();
  await page.keyboard.press("Delete");
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Eliminar Ensayo 6", exact: true })
    .click();
  await expect(page.locator(".note-row")).toHaveCount(7);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Carpetas", exact: true }).click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: /Eliminadas recientemente/ }).click();
  await page
    .getByRole("button", {
      name: "Eliminar definitivamente Ensayo 6",
      exact: true,
    })
    .click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancelar", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText("Ensayo 6", { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Recuperar Ensayo 6", exact: true })
    .click();
  await expect(page.getByText("No hay notas eliminadas.")).toBeVisible();
});

  await page.keyboard.insertText(" final");
  await area.press("ControlOrMeta+z");
  await expect(area).toHaveText("Título imaginario\nSegunda línea", {
    useInnerText: true,
  });
  await area.press("ControlOrMeta+Shift+z");
  await expect(area).toHaveText("Título imaginario\nSegunda línea final", {
    useInnerText: true,
  });
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Volver a las notas" }).click();
  await page.reload();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: /Título imaginario/ }).click();
  await expect(area).toHaveText("Título imaginario\nSegunda línea final", {
    useInnerText: true,
  });
});

  expect(await area.evaluate((el) => el === document.activeElement)).toBe(true);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Insertar tabla de texto" }).click();
  await expect(area).toContainText("Columna A | Columna B");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Opciones de texto" }).click();
  await expect(page.locator(".format-menu")).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Opciones de texto" }).click();
  await expect(page.locator(".format-menu")).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Opciones de escritura" }).click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Añadir viñeta" }).click();
  await expect(area).toContainText("• ");
  await page.locator("input[type=file]").setInputFiles({
    name: "ensayo.txt",
    mimeType: "text/plain",
    buffer: Buffer.from("<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>"),
  });
  await expect(area).toContainText("<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>");
  await expect(page.locator(".writing-area img")).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.locator("input[type=file]").setInputFiles({
    name: "grande.txt",
    mimeType: "text/plain",
    buffer: Buffer.alloc(10001, 120),
  });
  await expect(page.locator(".editor-hint")).toContainText("menos de 10 KB");
});

test("U08: dos pestañas no pisan notas distintas ni una edición simultánea", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await prepare(page);
  const second = await page.context().newPage();
  await second.goto("/");
  await page.locator(".note-row").filter({ hasText: "Ensayo 1" }).click();
  await second.locator(".note-row").filter({ hasText: "Ensayo 2" }).click();
  await page.getByRole("textbox").fill("Primera pestaña ficticia");
  await second.getByRole("textbox").fill("Segunda pestaña ficticia");
  page.on("dialog", (d) => d.accept());
  await page.reload();
  await expect(
    page.locator(".note-row").filter({ hasText: "Primera pestaña ficticia" }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await expect(
    page.locator(".note-row").filter({ hasText: "Segunda pestaña ficticia" }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await page
    .locator(".note-row")
    .filter({ hasText: "Primera pestaña ficticia" })
    .click();
  second.on("dialog", (d) => d.accept());
  await second.reload();
  await second
    .locator(".note-row")
    .filter({ hasText: "Primera pestaña ficticia" })
    .click();
  await page.getByRole("textbox").fill("Cambio concurrente ficticio");
  await second.getByRole("textbox").fill("Borrador en conflicto ficticio");
  await expect(second.getByRole("alert")).toContainText("otra pestaña");
  await page.reload();
  await expect(
    page
      .locator(".note-row")
      .filter({ hasText: "Cambio concurrente ficticio" }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await expect(
    page
      .locator(".note-row")
      .filter({ hasText: "Borrador en conflicto ficticio" }),
  ).toHaveCount(0);
});

===== ARCHIVO: tests/audit/delete-performance.spec.ts =====
import { test, expect, type Page } from "playwright/test";
import { prepare, fixtures } from "./fixtures";

// Each worker uses a disposable artist: session limits stay real and isolated.
test.use({
  extraHTTPHeaders: {
    "oai-authenticated-user-id": `deletion-test-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
    "oai-authenticated-user-email": "deletion@fiction.invalid",
  },
});

async function activateDelete(page: Page) {
  const button = page.getByRole("button", {
    name: "Eliminar nota",
    exact: true,
  });
  if ((page.viewportSize()?.width ?? 1280) < 1000) await button.tap();
  else await button.click();
}

test("D01: eliminar copia de actuación también retira el original del listado", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  const notes = fixtures();
  notes[3].text = "600000001";
  await prepare(page, notes);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Menú y área del artista" }).click();
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Preparar sesión", exact: true })
    .click();
  await page.locator(".note-row").filter({ hasText: "600000001" }).click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Opciones de nota" }).click();
  await activateDelete(page);
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Notas", exact: true }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await expect(
    page.locator(".note-row").filter({ hasText: "600000001" }),
  ).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.reload();
  await expect(
    page.locator(".note-row").filter({ hasText: "600000001" }),
  ).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Carpetas", exact: true }).click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: /Eliminadas recientemente/ }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText("600000001", { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Recuperar 600000001", exact: true })
    .click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Volver a Carpetas" }).click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: /^Notas/ }).click();
  await expect(
    page.locator(".note-row").filter({ hasText: "600000001" }),
  ).toHaveCount(1);
});

test("D02: eliminar se activa por toque aunque Safari no entregue click", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await prepare(page);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Crear nueva nota" }).click();
  await page.getByRole("textbox").fill("Borrado de ensayo ficticio");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Opciones de nota" }).click();
  const button = page.getByRole("button", {
    name: "Eliminar nota",
    exact: true,
  });
  await button.dispatchEvent("pointerdown", {
    pointerId: 7,
    isPrimary: true,
    pointerType: "touch",
    button: 0,
    clientX: 100,
    clientY: 200,
  });
  await button.dispatchEvent("pointerup", {
    pointerId: 7,
    isPrimary: true,
    pointerType: "touch",
    button: 0,
    clientX: 100,
    clientY: 200,
  });
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Notas", exact: true }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await expect(
    page.locator(".note-row").filter({ hasText: "Borrado de ensayo ficticio" }),
  ).toHaveCount(0);
});

test("D03: borrado de nota temporal descarta respuesta tardía y no guarda datos en papelera", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await prepare(page);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Menú y área del artista" }).click();
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Preparar sesión", exact: true })
    .click();
  let release!: () => void;
  const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
    release = resolve;
  });
  await page.route("**/api/query", async (route) => {
    const b = route.request().postDataJSON();
    await gate;
    await route.fulfill({
      json: {
        ...b,
        phone: "+34600000001",
        status: "completado",
        providerMs: 1,
        result: {
          requestId: b.requestId,
          phone: "+34600000001",
          final: true,
          found: true,
          name: "Respuesta ficticia tardía",
        },
      },
    });
  });
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Crear nueva nota" }).click();
  const request = page.waitForRequest("**/api/query");
  await page.getByRole("textbox").fill("600000001");
  await request;
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Opciones de nota" }).click();
  await activateDelete(page);
  release();
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Notas", exact: true }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator(".note-row")).toHaveCount(8);
  await expect(page.locator(".peek-result")).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Carpetas", exact: true }).click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: /Eliminadas recientemente/ }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText("No hay notas eliminadas.")).toBeVisible();
  expect(
    await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem("notas-escena.ordinary.v1")),
  ).not.toContain("Respuesta ficticia tardía");
});

===== ARCHIVO: tests/audit/fixtures.ts =====
import type { Page } from "playwright/test";
export const key = "notas-escena.ordinary.v1";
export function fixtures(count = 8, length = 80) {
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => ({
    id: `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(i + 1).padStart(12, "0")}`,
    text: `Ensayo ${i + 1}\n${"Un recuerdo imaginario. ".repeat(Math.ceil(length / 24)).slice(0, length)}`,
    pinned: i < 3,
    updated: Date.now() - (i < 3 ? i : i < 5 ? 1 : i < 7 ? 4 : 15) * 86400000,
  }));
}
export async function prepare(page: Page, notes = fixtures()) {
  const origin = new URL(process.env.AUDIT_BASE_URL ?? "http://127.0.0.1:5178");
  if (!["127.0.0.1", "localhost"].includes(origin.hostname))
    throw Error("Audit fixtures require loopback");
  await page.addInitScript(
    ({ key, notes }) => {
      if (!sessionStorage.getItem("audit-fixture-initialized")) {
        localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(notes));
        sessionStorage.setItem("audit-fixture-initialized", "yes");
      }
    },
    { key, notes },
  );
  await page.goto("/");
  await page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Notas", exact: true }).waitFor();
}

===== ARCHIVO: tests/automatic-lookup.test.ts =====
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import {
  AutomaticLookup,
  eligiblePhone,
} from "../lib/client/automatic-lookup.ts";
const context = {
  sessionId: "session",
  noteId: "note",
  revision: 1,
  generation: 1,
};
test("detección automática exige un único móvil completo seleccionado", () => {
  const allowed = new Set(["+34600000001"]);
  assert.equal(eligiblePhone("600 000-001", allowed), "+34600000001");
  for (const text of [
    "60000000",
    "611111111",
    "600000001 700000002",
    "+34+34600000001",
    "800000001",
  ])
    assert.equal(eligiblePhone(text, allowed), null);
});
test("una consulta automática por sesión, nota y número; editar no provoca reintentos", () => {
  const lookup = new AutomaticLookup();
  assert.equal(lookup.reserve(context, "+34600000001"), true);
  assert.equal(
    lookup.reserve({ ...context, revision: 2 }, "+34600000001"),
    false,
  );
  assert.equal(
    lookup.reserve({ ...context, noteId: "other" }, "+34600000001"),
    true,
  );
  lookup.reset();
  assert.equal(lookup.reserve(context, "+34600000001"), true);
});
test("peek solo mientras se mantiene pulsado; soltar oculta y permite repetir sin consultar", () => {
  const lookup = new AutomaticLookup();
  lookup.stage(context, "\n\nNombre: Persona ficticia");
  assert.equal(lookup.peek(context), null);
  lookup.startHold(context);
  assert.equal(lookup.peek(context), "\n\nNombre: Persona ficticia");
  lookup.release();
  assert.equal(lookup.peek(context), null);
  lookup.startHold(context);
  assert.equal(lookup.peek(context), "\n\nNombre: Persona ficticia");
});
test("cambio de nota, revisión, sesión o generación descarta la respuesta reservada", () => {
  for (const changed of [
    { ...context, noteId: "other" },
    { ...context, revision: 2 },
    { ...context, sessionId: "other" },
    { ...context, generation: 2 },
  ]) {
    const lookup = new AutomaticLookup();
    lookup.stage(context, "respuesta");
    lookup.startHold(changed);
    assert.equal(lookup.peek(changed), null);
    assert.equal(lookup.result(context), null);
  }
  const lookup = new AutomaticLookup();
  lookup.stage(context, "respuesta");
  lookup.discard();
  assert.equal(lookup.result(context), null);
});
test("soltar antes de la respuesta evita que aparezca después; otro contexto nunca revela", () => {
  const lookup = new AutomaticLookup();
  lookup.startHold(context);
  lookup.release();
  lookup.stage(context, "ficticio");
  assert.equal(lookup.peek(context), null);
  lookup.startHold(context);
  assert.equal(lookup.peek(context), "ficticio");
  assert.equal(lookup.peek({ ...context, revision: 2 }), null);
  lookup.discard();
  assert.equal(lookup.peek(context), null);
});

===== ARCHIVO: tests/browser/automatic.spec.ts =====
import { test, expect } from "playwright/test";
test.use({ serviceWorkers: "block" });
test("detección estable, autorización, respuesta reservada y descarte por revisión", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  let requests = 0;
  page.on("request", (r) => {
    if (r.url().endsWith("/api/query")) requests++;
  });
  await page.goto("/signin-with-chatgpt?return_to=/");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Crear nueva nota" }).click();
  const text = page.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Texto de la nota" });
  await text.fill("600000001");
  await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
  expect(requests).toBe(0); // no artist session
  await page.locator(".link-tool").tap();
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Área del artista", exact: true }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole("checkbox")).toHaveCount(2);
  for (const participant of await page.getByRole("checkbox").all())
    await participant.check();
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Preparar sesión", exact: true })
    .click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Crear nueva nota" }).click();
  for (const value of ["60000000", "611111111", "600000001 700000002"]) {
    await text.fill(value);
    await page.waitForTimeout(950);
  }
  expect(requests).toBe(0);
  await text.fill("600000001");
  await page.waitForTimeout(300);
  await text.fill("6000000012"); // edits before the stable timer cancel transmission
  await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
  expect(requests).toBe(0);
  await text.fill("+34 600 000 001");
  const link = page.locator(".link-tool");
  await expect(link).toHaveAttribute("aria-label", "Eslabones: recibido");
  await expect(text).toHaveText("+34 600 000 001");
  expect(requests).toBe(1);
  // Safari may commit a duplicate input event when the keyboard focus changes.
  await text.dispatchEvent("input", { bubbles: true });
  await expect(link).toHaveAttribute("aria-label", "Eslabones: recibido");
  await text.press("ControlOrMeta+End");
  await page.keyboard.insertText("\nEnsayo"); // same phone, different revision: discard, no automatic retry
  await page.waitForTimeout(1100);
  expect(requests).toBe(1);
  await expect(link).toHaveAttribute("aria-label", "Eslabones: preparado");
  const originalText = await text.innerText();
  await link.tap(); // explicit query starts, release must prevent late revelation
  await expect(link).toHaveAttribute("aria-label", "Eslabones: recibido");
  await expect(page.locator(".peek-result")).toHaveCount(0);
  expect(await text.innerText()).toBe(originalText);
  expect(requests).toBe(2);
  const position = await link.boundingBox();
  await page.mouse.move(
    position!.x + position!.width / 2,
    position!.y + position!.height / 2,
  );
  await page.mouse.down();
  await expect(page.locator(".peek-result")).toContainText(
    "Nombre: Alba Ejemplo",
  );
  expect(await text.innerText()).toBe(originalText);
  expect(await text.evaluate((el) => el === document.activeElement)).toBe(true);
  await page.mouse.move(2, 2); // release outside the control is still captured
  await page.mouse.up();
  await expect(page.locator(".peek-result")).toHaveCount(0);
  await link.dispatchEvent("pointerdown", {
    pointerId: 2,
    isPrimary: true,
    pointerType: "touch",
    button: 0,
  });
  await expect(page.locator(".peek-result")).toContainText(
    "Nombre: Alba Ejemplo",
  );
  await link.dispatchEvent("pointercancel", {
    pointerId: 2,
    pointerType: "touch",
  });
  await expect(page.locator(".peek-result")).toHaveCount(0);
  expect(requests).toBe(2);
  await text.fill("700000002");
  await expect(link).toHaveAttribute("aria-label", "Eslabones: consultando");
  const box = await link.boundingBox();
  await page.mouse.move(box!.x + box!.width / 2, box!.y + box!.height / 2);
  await page.mouse.down();
  await expect(page.locator(".peek-result")).toContainText(
    "Nombre: Leo Ensayo",
  );
  await expect(text).toHaveText("700000002");
  await page.mouse.up();
  await expect(page.locator(".peek-result")).toHaveCount(0);
  expect(requests).toBe(3);
  // Keyboard activation follows the same hold/release contract.
  await link.focus();
  await page.keyboard.down("Space");
  await expect(page.locator(".peek-result")).toContainText(
    "Nombre: Leo Ensayo",
  );
  await page.keyboard.up("Space");
  await expect(page.locator(".peek-result")).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.keyboard.down("Space");
  await expect(page.locator(".peek-result")).toBeVisible();
  await page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event("blur")));
  await expect(page.locator(".peek-result")).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.keyboard.up("Space");
  expect(requests).toBe(3);
});

      !m.text().includes("Fetch API cannot load")

    "aria-label",
    "Eslabones: error",
  );
  await page.unroute("**/api/query");
  await page.route("**/api/query", async (route) => {
    const b = route.request().postDataJSON();
    await route.fulfill({
      json: {
        ...b,
        phone: "+34600000001",
        status: "completado",
        providerMs: 1,
        result: {
          requestId: b.requestId,
          phone: "+34600000001",
          final: true,
          found: true,
          name: "<script>window.COMPROMISED=true</script>",
        },
      },
    });
  });
  await page.locator(".link-tool").click();
  await expect(page.locator(".link-tool")).toHaveAttribute(
    "aria-label",
    "Eslabones: recibido",
  );
  const maliciousBox = await page.locator(".link-tool").boundingBox();
  await page.mouse.move(
    maliciousBox!.x + maliciousBox!.width / 2,
    maliciousBox!.y + maliciousBox!.height / 2,
  );
  await page.mouse.down();
  await expect(page.locator(".peek-result")).toContainText(
    "<script>window.COMPROMISED=true</script>",
  );
  await expect(writing).toHaveText("600000001");
  expect(
    (await page.locator(".peek-result").innerText()).match(/Nombre:/g),
  ).toHaveLength(1);
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => "COMPROMISED" in window)).toBe(false);
  expect(await page.locator(".peek-result script").count()).toBe(0);
  await page.mouse.up();
  await expect(page.locator(".peek-result")).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.unroute("**/api/query");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Deshacer", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(writing).toHaveText("600000001");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Opciones de nota" }).click();
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Área del artista", exact: true })
    .click();
  await expect(page.locator(".diagnostics")).toContainText(
    "Resultado retirado",
  );
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Borrar sesión y resultados" })
    .click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Volver a Notas" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText("8 notas", { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  const cached = await page.evaluate(async () => {
    const urls: string[] = [];
    for (const name of await caches.keys()) {
      if (name.startsWith("notas-public-"))
        for (const req of await (await caches.open(name)).keys())
          urls.push(new URL(req.url).pathname);
    }
    return urls;
  });
  expect(cached.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  expect(
    cached.every(
      (path) =>
        path.startsWith("/icons/") ||
        ["/offline.html", "/offline.css", "/manifest.json"].includes(path),
    ),
  ).toBe(true);
  expect(errors).toEqual([]);
});

import { test, expect } from "playwright/test";
// These UI cases deliberately mock configuration. PWA caching is exercised by flow.spec.ts.
test.use({ serviceWorkers: "block" });
test("área del artista: comprobación Telegram no consulta números y configuración incompleta queda bloqueada", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  let configured = true,
    checks = 0,
    queries = 0;
  await page.route("**/api/config", (route) =>
    route.fulfill({
      json: {
        mode: "real",
        transport: "telegram",
        artist: "Artista ficticio",
        artistId: "fictional-artist",
        participants: [],
        realConfigured: configured,
      },
    }),
  );
  await page.route("**/api/provider-check", (route) => {
    checks++;
    return route.fulfill({
      json: {
        transport: "telegram",
        authenticated: true,
        targetVerified: true,
        webhookAbsent: true,
        communication: "not_verified",
      },
    });
  });
  page.on("request", (request) => {
    if (request.url().endsWith("/api/query")) queries++;
  });
  const loaded = page.waitForResponse((response) =>
    response.url().endsWith("/api/config"),
  );
  await page.goto("/signin-with-chatgpt?return_to=/");
  await loaded;
  await expect(page.getByText("8 notas", { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Menú y área del artista" }).click();
  await expect(
    page.getByText("Telegram · bot propio", { exact: true }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  const check = page.getByRole("button", {
    name: "Comprobar conexión del bot",
  });
  await check.click();
  await expect(page.getByRole("status")).toContainText("todavía pendientes");
  expect(checks).toBe(1);
  expect(queries).toBe(0);
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("button", { name: "Preparar sesión", exact: true }),
  ).toBeDisabled();
  // Actual local server stays in demo and rejects a Telegram check instead of contacting any provider.
  expect((await page.request.get("/api/provider-check")).status()).toBe(409);
  configured = false;
  const reloaded = page.waitForResponse((response) =>
    response.url().endsWith("/api/config"),
  );
  await page.reload();
  await reloaded;
  await expect(page.getByText("8 notas", { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Menú y área del artista" }).click();
  await expect(check).toBeDisabled();
  expect(queries).toBe(0);
});

import { test } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import {
  normalizePhone,
  validateResult,
  formatResult,
  canInsert,
} from "../lib/domain.ts";
for (const input of [
  "600000001",
  "600 000-001",
  "+34 600 000 001",
  "0034-600-000-001",
]) {
  test(`normaliza ${input}`, () =>
    assert.equal(normalizePhone(input), "+34600000001"));
}
for (const input of [
  "60000000",
  "800000001",
  "+34+34600000001",
  "600000001 700000002",
  "600.000.001",
  "600000001 ext 1",
  "600000001\n600000001",
  "1234567890",
]) {
  test(`rechaza entrada ambigua/inválida ${input}`, () =>
    assert.throws(() => normalizePhone(input)));
}
test("acepta número en primera línea y preserva texto de la nota fuera de normalización", () => {
  assert.equal(
    normalizePhone("Ideas\n+34 600-000-001\nEscena"),
    "+34600000001",
  );
});
test("valida correlación y campos parciales, no inventa datos", () => {
  assert.throws(() =>
    validateResult(
      { requestId: "b", phone: "+34600000001", final: true },
      "a",
      "+34600000001",
    ),
  );
  assert.throws(() =>
    validateResult(
      { requestId: "a", phone: "+34600000001", final: false },
      "a",
      "+34600000001",
    ),
  );
  const r = validateResult(
    {
      requestId: "a",
      phone: "+34600000001",
      final: true,
      name: "<script>alert(1)</script>",
    },
    "a",
    "+34600000001",
  );
  assert.equal(
    formatResult(r),
    "Número: +34600000001\nNombre: <script>alert(1)</script>",
  );
  assert.throws(() =>
    validateResult(
      {
        requestId: "a",
        phone: "+34600000001",
        final: true,
        name: { html: "x" },
      },
      "a",
      "+34600000001",
    ),
  );
});
test("no inserta tras editar, cambiar nota o reiniciar sesión", () => {
  const a = { sessionId: "s", noteId: "n", revision: 2, generation: 1 };
  assert.equal(canInsert(a, a), true);
  for (const b of [
    { ...a, revision: 3 },
    { ...a, noteId: "m" },
    { ...a, sessionId: "t" },
    { ...a, generation: 2 },
  ])
    assert.equal(canInsert(a, b), false);
});

  h.record({ text: "Título\nTexto añadido", start: 20, end: 20 });
  assert.equal(h.undo()?.text, "Título\nTexto");
  assert.equal(h.redo()?.text, "Título\nTexto añadido");
  for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++)
    h.record({ text: "x".repeat(10000) + i, start: 0, end: 0 });
  assert.ok(h.depth <= 50);
  assert.ok(h.size <= 200000);
});

import { test } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";

  groups,

  persistNotes,

  type Note,

test("agrupación por fechas reales y búsqueda sin distinguir acentos", () => {
  const now = Date.parse("2026-10-11T14:00:00Z");
  const notes = [
    {
      id: "a",
      text: "Café\nRecordatorio",
      pinned: false,
      updated: now - 86400000,
    },
    { id: "b", text: "Fijada", pinned: true, updated: now - 30 * 86400000 },
  ];
  assert.deepEqual(
    groups(notes, now).map((g) => g[0]),
    ["Fijadas", "Ayer"],
  );
  assert.equal(findNotes(notes, "cafe")[0].id, "a");
});
test("no persiste contenido de actuación ni resultados", () => {
  let stored = "";
  Object.defineProperty(globalThis, "localStorage", {
    configurable: true,
    value: {
      setItem(_k: string, v: string) {
        stored = v;
      },
      getItem() {
        return stored;
      },
    },
  });
  const notes: Note[] = [
    { id: "ordinary", text: "Lista de la compra", updated: 1, pinned: false },
    {
      id: "performance",
      text: "Número\nNombre: DATOS-PERSONALES",
      updated: 2,
      pinned: false,
      volatile: true,
    },
  ];
  persistNotes(notes);
  assert.ok(!stored.includes("DATOS-PERSONALES"));
  assert.equal(loadNotes().length, 1);
});

test("borrado recuperable conserva texto, fechas y fijación; actuación se descarta", async () => {
  const { deleteNote, restoreNote } = await import("../lib/client/notes.ts");
  const ordinary: Note = {
    id: "ordinary",
    text: "Ficción\nSegunda línea",
    pinned: true,
    updated: 100,
  };
  const performance: Note = { ...ordinary, id: "performance", volatile: true };
  const deleted = deleteNote([ordinary, performance], "ordinary", 200);
  assert.equal(deleted[0].deleted, 200);
  assert.equal(groups(deleted, 200).flatMap((g) => g[1]).length, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(restoreNote(deleted, "ordinary")[0], ordinary);
  assert.equal(deleteNote([performance], "performance", 200).length, 0);
});
test("papelera persistente excluye actuación y caduca a los 30 días", () => {
  let stored = "";
  Object.defineProperty(globalThis, "localStorage", {
    configurable: true,
    value: {
      setItem(_k: string, v: string) {
        stored = v;
      },
      getItem() {
        return stored;
      },
    },
  });
  const now = Date.now();
  persistNotes([
    {
      id: "recover",
      text: "Recuperable ficticio",
      updated: now,
      deleted: now - 1000,
      pinned: true,
    },
    {
      id: "expired",
      text: "Caducado ficticio",
      updated: now,
      deleted: now - 31 * 86400000,
      pinned: false,
    },
    {
      id: "secret",
      text: "RESPUESTA-PRIVADA",
      updated: now,
      deleted: now,
      volatile: true,
      pinned: false,
    },
  ]);
  assert.ok(!stored.includes("RESPUESTA-PRIVADA"));
  const loaded = loadNotes();
  assert.equal(loaded.length, 1);
  assert.equal(loaded[0].id, "recover");
  assert.equal(loaded[0].pinned, true);
});

test("agrupa por día de calendario aunque cambie el horario de verano", () => {
  const now = Date.parse("2026-03-29T01:30:00Z");
  const previousDay = Date.parse("2026-03-28T22:30:00Z");
  const sameDay = Date.parse("2026-03-28T23:30:00Z");
  const notes: Note[] = [
    {
      id: "yesterday",
      text: "Ayer ficticio",
      updated: previousDay,
      pinned: false,
    },
    { id: "today", text: "Hoy ficticio", updated: sameDay, pinned: false },
  ];
  assert.deepEqual(
    groups(notes, now).map((g) => [g[0], g[1][0].id]),
    [
      ["Hoy", "today"],
      ["Ayer", "yesterday"],
    ],
  );
});

test("guardado combina notas distintas y rechaza conflicto de la misma nota", async () => {
  const { mergeOrdinaryNotes, NoteConflict } =
    await import("../lib/client/notes.ts");
  const a: Note = { id: "a", text: "Ficción A", updated: 1, pinned: false };
  const b: Note = { ...a, id: "b", text: "Ficción B" };
  const editA = { ...a, text: "Nueva ficción A", updated: 2 };
  const editB = { ...b, text: "Nueva ficción B", updated: 3 };
  assert.deepEqual(mergeOrdinaryNotes([a, b], [a, editB], [editA, b]), [
    editA,
    editB,
  ]);
  assert.throws(
    () =>
      mergeOrdinaryNotes(
        [a, b],
        [{ ...a, text: "Otra ficción" }, b],
        [editA, b],
      ),
    NoteConflict,
  );
  assert.deepEqual(mergeOrdinaryNotes([a, b], [b], [a, editB]), [editB]);
});

test("eliminar una copia temporal borra todas sus copias y permite recuperar el original exacto", async () => {
  const { deleteNote, restoreNote } = await import("../lib/client/notes.ts");
  const original: Note = {
    id: "original",
    text: "Texto ficticio original",
    pinned: true,
    updated: 123,
  };
  const copy: Note = {
    ...original,
    id: "copy",
    sourceId: original.id,
    text: "Edición privada temporal",
    volatile: true,
  };
  const copy2: Note = { ...copy, id: "copy2" };
  const other: Note = { ...original, id: "other", text: "Otra nota" };
  const deleted = deleteNote([original, copy, copy2, other], copy.id, 456);
  assert.equal(deleted.length, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(deleted[0], { ...original, deleted: 456 });
  assert.deepEqual(restoreNote(deleted, original.id), [original, other]);
  assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(deleted).includes("Edición privada"));
  assert.deepEqual(deleteNote([original, copy], original.id, 456), [
    { ...original, deleted: 456 },
  ]);
});

test("API correlaciona, rechaza parcial/malicioso estructural, limita respuesta y no reintenta", async () => {
  const original = globalThis.fetch;
  let calls = 0;
  let response: unknown = {
    requestId: "r",
    phone: input.phone,
    final: true,
    name: "<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>",
  };
  globalThis.fetch = async (_url, options) => {
    calls++;
    assert.equal(
      (options?.headers as Record<string, string>)["Idempotency-Key"],
      "r",
    );
    return Response.json(response);
  };
  try {
    const provider = new HttpProvider(config);
    assert.equal(
      (await provider.lookup(input)).name,
      "<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>",
    );
    response = {
      requestId: "other",
      phone: input.phone,
      final: true,
      name: "x",
    };
    await assert.rejects(provider.lookup(input), /no corresponde/);
    response = { requestId: "r", phone: input.phone, final: false };
    await assert.rejects(provider.lookup(input), /parcial/);
    response = {
      requestId: "r",
      phone: input.phone,
      final: true,
      name: "x".repeat(10000),
    };
    await assert.rejects(provider.lookup(input), /excesiva/);
    assert.equal(calls, 4);
  } finally {
    globalThis.fetch = original;
  }
});

===== ARCHIVO: tests/service.test.ts =====
import { test } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { DatabaseSync } from "node:sqlite";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { Service } from "../lib/server/service.ts";
import { Store, type Database } from "../lib/server/store.ts";
import { digest, type QueryResult } from "../lib/domain.ts";
import type { Provider, ProviderInput } from "../lib/server/providers.ts";
function fixture(provider?: Provider, timeout = 200) {
  const db = new DatabaseSync(":memory:");
  db.exec(
    readFileSync(
      new URL("../drizzle/0000_bouncy_scalphunter.sql", import.meta.url),
      "utf8",
    ),
  );
  const adapter: Database = {
    prepare(sql) {
      let args: unknown[] = [];
      const stmt = db.prepare(sql);
      return {
        bind(...values: unknown[]) {
          args = values;
          return this;
        },
        async first<T>() {
          return (stmt.get(...(args as (string | number | null)[])) ??
            null) as T | null;
        },
        async all<T>() {
          return {
            results: stmt.all(...(args as (string | number | null)[])) as T[],
          };
        },
        async run() {
          return stmt.run(...(args as (string | number | null)[]));
        },
      };
    },
  };
  return {
    db,
    service: new Service(new Store(adapter), {}, provider, timeout),
  };
}
function deferredProvider() {
  let calls = 0,
    resolve!: (value: QueryResult) => void;
  let input!: ProviderInput;
  const provider: Provider = {
    mode: "demo",
    lookup(i) {
      calls++;
      input = i;
      return new Promise((r) => {
        resolve = r;
      });
    },
  };
  return {
    provider,
    get calls() {
      return calls;
    },
    get input() {
      return input;
    },
    finish(found = true) {
      resolve({
        requestId: input.requestId,
        phone: input.phone,
        final: true,
        found,
        ...(found ? { country: "España", name: "Persona inventada" } : {}),
      });
    },
  };
}
async function body(sessionId: string, text = "600 000-001") {
  return {
    sessionId,
    requestId: crypto.randomUUID(),
    noteId: crypto.randomUUID(),
    text,
    revision: await digest(text),
  };
}
const tick = () => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 8));
test("consulta autorizada, duplicados bloqueados y metadatos sin resultado ni teléfono", async () => {
  const p = deferredProvider(),
    { service, db } = fixture(p.provider);
  const s = await service.start("artist", { participantIds: ["demo-alba"] });
  const b = await body(s.id);
  const first = service.query("artist", b, s.csrf);
  await tick();
  await assert.rejects(
    service.query("artist", b, s.csrf),
    /petición ya se recibió/,
  );
  assert.equal(p.calls, 1);
  p.finish();
  const r = await first;
  assert.equal(r.result?.name, "Persona inventada");
  assert.equal(r.noteId, b.noteId);
  await assert.rejects(
    service.query("artist", b, s.csrf),
    /petición ya se recibió/,
  );
  const rows = JSON.stringify(db.prepare("SELECT * FROM queries").all());
  assert.ok(!rows.includes("600000001"));
  assert.ok(!rows.includes("Persona inventada"));
  assert.ok(!rows.includes("country"));
});
test("bloquea otros artistas, CSRF incorrecto, titular no seleccionado y revisión falsa antes de proveedor", async () => {
  const p = deferredProvider(),
    { service } = fixture(p.provider),
    s = await service.start("artist", { participantIds: ["demo-alba"] }),
    b = await body(s.id);
  await assert.rejects(service.query("another", b, s.csrf), /Sesión caducada/);
  await assert.rejects(service.query("artist", b, "forged"), /Verificación/);
  await assert.rejects(
    service.query("artist", await body(s.id, "700000002"), s.csrf),
    /no está autorizado/,
  );
  await assert.rejects(
    service.query("artist", await body(s.id, "611111111"), s.csrf),
    /no está autorizado/,
  );
  await assert.rejects(
    service.query("artist", { ...b, revision: "0".repeat(64) }, s.csrf),
    /revisión no coincide/,
  );
  assert.equal(p.calls, 0);
});
test("serializa peticiones concurrentes por sesión", async () => {
  const p = deferredProvider(),
    { service } = fixture(p.provider),
    s = await service.start("artist", { participantIds: ["demo-alba"] });
  const a = service.query("artist", await body(s.id), s.csrf);
  await tick();
  await assert.rejects(
    service.query("artist", await body(s.id), s.csrf),
    /consulta pendiente/,
  );
  p.finish();
  await a;
  assert.equal(p.calls, 1);
});
test("borrar o reiniciar sesión descarta respuesta en curso", async () => {
  const p = deferredProvider(),
    { service, db } = fixture(p.provider),
    s = await service.start("artist", { participantIds: ["demo-alba"] });
  const a = service.query("artist", await body(s.id), s.csrf);
  await tick();
  await service.start("artist", { participantIds: ["demo-alba"] });
  p.finish();
  await assert.rejects(a, /sesión cambió/);
  assert.equal(db.prepare("SELECT * FROM queries").all().length, 0);
});
test("timeout con respuesta tardía no cambia el estado ni reenvía", async () => {
  const p = deferredProvider(),
    { service, db } = fixture(p.provider, 25),
    s = await service.start("artist", { participantIds: ["demo-alba"] });
  await assert.rejects(
    service.query("artist", await body(s.id), s.csrf),
    /Tiempo de espera/,
  );
  p.finish();
  await tick();
  assert.equal(
    db.prepare("SELECT status FROM queries").get()?.status,
    "tiempo agotado",
  );
  assert.equal(p.calls, 1);
});
test("sin resultado y errores de red liberan la sesión", async () => {
  const p = deferredProvider(),
    { service, db } = fixture(p.provider),
    s = await service.start("artist", { participantIds: ["demo-alba"] });
  const a = service.query("artist", await body(s.id), s.csrf);
  await tick();
  p.finish(false);
  assert.equal((await a).status, "sin resultado");
  assert.equal(
    db.prepare("SELECT active_query FROM sessions").get()?.active_query,
    null,
  );
  const network = fixture({
    mode: "demo",
    async lookup() {
      throw new Error("secret phone private provider error");
    },
  });
  const t = await network.service.start("artist", {
    participantIds: ["demo-alba"],
  });
  await assert.rejects(
    network.service.query("artist", await body(t.id), t.csrf),
    /No se pudo contactar/,
  );
  assert.ok(
    !JSON.stringify(network.db.prepare("SELECT * FROM queries").all()).includes(
      "secret",
    ),
  );
});
test("límites persistentes por artista y sesión", async () => {
  const { service } = fixture();
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) await service.rate("artist", "query", 20);
  await assert.rejects(service.rate("artist", "query", 20), /Límite alcanzado/);
  const s = await service.start("second-artist", {
    participantIds: ["demo-alba"],
  });
  await service.store.run(
    "UPDATE sessions SET query_count=10 WHERE id=?",
    s.id,
  );
  await assert.rejects(
    service.query("second-artist", await body(s.id), s.csrf),
    /límite de sesión/,
  );
});

===== ARCHIVO: tests/telegram.test.ts =====
import { test } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { DatabaseSync } from "node:sqlite";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import {
  TelegramProvider,
  parseTelegramResult,
} from "../lib/server/telegram.ts";
import { Store, type Database } from "../lib/server/store.ts";
import { Service } from "../lib/server/service.ts";
import { digest } from "../lib/domain.ts";

const config = {
  PROVIDER_MODE: "real",
  PROVIDER_TRANSPORT: "telegram",
  PROVIDER_AUTHORIZED: "true",
  TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN: "12345:test-only-secret",
  TELEGRAM_TARGET_BOT_ID: "54321",
  TELEGRAM_TARGET_USERNAME: "TrueCalleRobot",
  TELEGRAM_PROTOCOL_CONFIRMED: "true",
  TELEGRAM_FINAL_SUFFIX: "END OF RESULT",
  TELEGRAM_NO_RESULT_TEXT: "NO RESULT",
};
const phone = "+34600000001";
const text = `Number: ${phone}\nCountry: Spain\nCarrier: Operador ficticio\nName: Persona ficticia\nEND OF RESULT`;
function fixture() {
  const db = new DatabaseSync(":memory:");
  for (const file of [
    "0000_bouncy_scalphunter.sql",
    "0001_robust_thunderball.sql",
  ])
    db.exec(
      readFileSync(new URL(`../drizzle/${file}`, import.meta.url), "utf8"),
    );
  const database: Database = {
    prepare(sql) {
      const stmt = db.prepare(sql);
      let args: unknown[] = [];
      return {
        bind(...values: unknown[]) {
          args = values;
          return this;
        },
        async first<T>() {
          return (stmt.get(...(args as (string | number | null)[])) ??
            null) as T | null;
        },
        async all<T>() {
          return {
            results: stmt.all(...(args as (string | number | null)[])) as T[],
          };
        },
        async run() {
          return stmt.run(...(args as (string | number | null)[]));
        },
      };
    },
  };
  return { db, store: new Store(database) };
}
const ok = (result: unknown) => Response.json({ ok: true, result });
const reply = (
  id = 7,
  replyId = 40,
  body = text,
  sender = 54321,
  chat = 54321,
) => ({
  update_id: id,
  message: {
    message_id: id,
    from: { id: sender, is_bot: true },
    chat: { id: chat, type: "private" },
    reply_to_message: { message_id: replyId },
    text: body,
  },
});
function input(signal = new AbortController().signal) {
  return {
    requestId: crypto.randomUUID(),
    phone,
    sessionId: crypto.randomUUID(),
    signal,
  };
}
function harness(updates: unknown[][] = [[reply()]]) {
  const calls: { method: string; body: Record<string, unknown> }[] = [];
  const fetcher = async (url: string | URL | Request, init?: RequestInit) => {
    const method = String(url).split("/").at(-1)!;
    const body = JSON.parse(String(init?.body ?? "{}"));
    calls.push({ method, body });
    if (method === "getMe") return ok({ id: 12345, is_bot: true });
    if (method === "getWebhookInfo") return ok({ url: "" });
    if (method === "getChat")
      return ok({ id: 54321, type: "private", username: "TrueCalleRobot" });
    if (method === "sendMessage")
      return ok({ message_id: 40, chat: { id: 54321, type: "private" } });
    if (method === "getUpdates") return ok(updates.shift() ?? []);
    throw Error("unexpected method");
  };
  return { calls, fetcher };
}
test("Telegram resuelve el bot por username antes de verificar su ID estable", async () => {
  const { store } = fixture();
  const h = harness();
  const provider = new TelegramProvider(config, store, h.fetcher);
  await provider.check(new AbortController().signal);
  assert.equal(
    h.calls.find((call) => call.method === "getChat")?.body.chat_id,
    "@TrueCalleRobot",
  );
});
test("Telegram requiere configuración y permiso; parsea texto ficticio, rechaza parcial, número distinto y campos duplicados", () => {
  const { store } = fixture();
  assert.throws(() => new TelegramProvider({}, store), /configuración/);
  const r = parseTelegramResult(text, "request", phone, config);
  assert.equal(r.name, "Persona ficticia");
  assert.equal(
    parseTelegramResult(`Number: ${phone}\nNO RESULT`, "request", phone, config)
      .found,
    false,
  );
  assert.throws(
    () =>
      parseTelegramResult(
        text.replace("END OF RESULT", ""),
        "request",
        phone,
        config,
      ),
    /parcial/,
  );
  assert.throws(
    () =>
      parseTelegramResult(
        text.replace(phone, "+34700000002"),
        "request",
        phone,
        config,
      ),
    /corresponde/,
  );
  assert.throws(
    () =>
      parseTelegramResult(
        text.replace("Name:", "Name: X\nName:"),
        "request",
        phone,
        config,
      ),
    /duplicado/,
  );
  assert.equal(
    parseTelegramResult(
      text.replace("Persona ficticia", "<script>evil()</script>"),
      "request",
      phone,
      config,
    ).name,
    "<script>evil()</script>",
  );
});
test("Telegram envía +34 una sola vez y acepta únicamente respuesta correlacionada de origen/conversación fijados", async () => {
  const { store, db } = fixture(),
    h = harness([
      [
        reply(1, 39),
        reply(2, 40, text, 999),
        reply(3, 40, text, 54321, 999),
        reply(4),
      ],
    ]);
  const p = new TelegramProvider(config, store, h.fetcher),
    i = input();
  const r = await p.lookup(i);
  assert.equal(r.requestId, i.requestId);
  assert.equal(r.phone, phone);
  assert.equal(h.calls.filter((c) => c.method === "sendMessage").length, 1);
  assert.equal(
    h.calls.find((c) => c.method === "sendMessage")?.body.text,
    phone,
  );
  assert.equal(
    h.calls.find((c) => c.method === "sendMessage")?.body.chat_id,
    54321,
  );
  const persisted = JSON.stringify(
    db.prepare("SELECT * FROM telegram_state").all(),
  );
  assert.ok(
    !persisted.includes(phone) &&
      !persisted.includes("Persona ficticia") &&
      !persisted.includes(config.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN),
  );
});
test("Telegram bloqueo global abarca distintas instancias; un segundo artista no envía mientras está pendiente", async () => {
  const { store } = fixture(),
    h = harness();
  let resolve!: (r: Response) => void;
  const blocked = async (url: string | URL | Request, init?: RequestInit) =>
    String(url).endsWith("getUpdates")
      ? new Promise<Response>((r) => {
          resolve = r;
        })
      : h.fetcher(url, init);
  const p = new TelegramProvider(config, store, blocked),
    i = input();
  const pending = p.lookup(i);
  while (!resolve) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1));
  await assert.rejects(
    new TelegramProvider(config, store, h.fetcher).lookup(input()),
    /pendiente/,
  );
  await assert.rejects(
    new TelegramProvider(
      { ...config, TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN: "12345:rotated-test-secret" },
      store,
      h.fetcher,
    ).lookup(input()),
    /pendiente/,
  );
  resolve(ok([reply()]));
  await pending;
  assert.equal(h.calls.filter((c) => c.method === "sendMessage").length, 1);
});
test("Telegram rechaza webhook activo y destinatario distinto antes de transmitir un teléfono", async () => {
  for (const method of ["getWebhookInfo", "getChat"]) {
    const { store } = fixture(),
      h = harness();
    const f = async (url: string | URL | Request, init?: RequestInit) =>
      String(url).endsWith(method)
        ? ok(
            method === "getChat"
              ? { id: 888, type: "private", username: "OtherBot" }
              : { url: "https://other.example/webhook" },
          )
        : h.fetcher(url, init);
    await assert.rejects(
      new TelegramProvider(config, store, f).lookup(input()),
    );
    assert.equal(h.calls.filter((c) => c.method === "sendMessage").length, 0);
  }
});
test("Telegram 429 conserva cooldown y no repite el envío; errores no filtran descripción ni token", async () => {
  const { store, db } = fixture(),
    h = harness();
  const f = async (url: string | URL | Request, init?: RequestInit) =>
    String(url).endsWith("sendMessage")
      ? Response.json(
          {
            ok: false,
            error_code: 429,
            description: config.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN,
            parameters: { retry_after: 60 },
          },
          { status: 429 },
        )
      : h.fetcher(url, init);
  await assert.rejects(
    new TelegramProvider(config, store, f).lookup(input()),
    (e: Error) => !e.message.includes(config.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN),
  );
  await assert.rejects(
    new TelegramProvider(config, store, h.fetcher).lookup(input()),
    /espera/,
  );
  assert.ok(
    (
      db.prepare("SELECT cooldown_until FROM telegram_state").get() as {
        cooldown_until: number;
      }
    ).cooldown_until > Date.now(),
  );
});
test("Telegram tras abortar descarta una respuesta tardía y libera el bloqueo sin responder al proveedor", async () => {
  const { store, db } = fixture(),
    h = harness();
  let resolve!: (r: Response) => void;
  const f = async (url: string | URL | Request, init?: RequestInit) =>
    String(url).endsWith("getUpdates")
      ? new Promise<Response>((r) => {
          resolve = r;
        })
      : h.fetcher(url, init);
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const pending = new TelegramProvider(config, store, f).lookup(
    input(controller.signal),
  );
  while (!resolve) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1));
  controller.abort();
  resolve(ok([reply()]));
  await assert.rejects(pending, /agotado/);
  assert.equal(
    (
      db.prepare("SELECT request_id FROM telegram_state").get() as {
        request_id: null;
      }
    ).request_id,
    null,
  );
  assert.equal(h.calls.filter((c) => c.method === "sendMessage").length, 1);
});
test("Telegram ignora mensajes parciales y duplicados; un error de capacidad no filtra descripción ni reintenta", async () => {
  const { store } = fixture(),
    h = harness([
      [reply(1, 40, text.replace("END OF RESULT", "")), reply(1), reply(2)],
    ]);
  assert.equal(
    (await new TelegramProvider(config, store, h.fetcher).lookup(input())).name,
    "Persona ficticia",
  );
  const { store: nextStore } = fixture(),
    next = harness();
  let sends = 0;
  const f = async (url: string | URL | Request, init?: RequestInit) => {
    if (String(url).endsWith("sendMessage")) {
      sends++;
      return Response.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error_code: 400,
          description: `USER_BOT_TO_BOT_DISABLED ${config.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}`,
        },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }
    return next.fetcher(url, init);
  };
  await assert.rejects(
    new TelegramProvider(config, nextStore, f).lookup(input()),
    (e: Error & { code?: string }) =>
      e.code === "TELEGRAM_BOT_TO_BOT_DISABLED" &&
      !e.message.includes(config.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN),
  );
  assert.equal(sends, 1);
});
test("Servicio Telegram comprueba autorización antes de enviar y correlaciona la ficha con nota, revisión y sesión", async () => {
  const { store, db } = fixture(),
    h = harness();
  const realConfig = {
    ...config,
    AUTHORIZED_PARTICIPANTS_JSON: JSON.stringify([
      {
        id: "fictional-holder",
        label: "Ficha ficticia",
        phone,
        artistId: "artist",
        consentRef: "fictional-evidence",
        ownershipVerifiedAt: new Date(Date.now() - 1000).toISOString(),
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 60000).toISOString(),
        scope: "lookup",
        provider: "telegram:@TrueCalleRobot:54321",
      },
    ]),
  };
  const service = new Service(
    store,
    realConfig,
    new TelegramProvider(realConfig, store, h.fetcher),
  );
  const session = await service.start("artist", {
    participantIds: ["fictional-holder"],
  });
  const makeBody = async (text: string) => ({
    sessionId: session.id,
    requestId: crypto.randomUUID(),
    noteId: crypto.randomUUID(),
    text,
    revision: await digest(text),
  });
  await assert.rejects(
    service.query("artist", await makeBody("700000002"), session.csrf),
    /no está autorizado/,
  );
  assert.equal(h.calls.length, 0);
  const body = await makeBody("600 000-001");
  const result = await service.query("artist", body, session.csrf);
  assert.equal(result.noteId, body.noteId);
  assert.equal(result.revision, body.revision);
  assert.equal(result.sessionId, session.id);
  assert.equal(result.result?.name, "Persona ficticia");
  await assert.rejects(
    service.query("artist", body, session.csrf),
    /ya se recibió/,
  );
  assert.equal(h.calls.filter((c) => c.method === "sendMessage").length, 1);
  const rows = JSON.stringify(db.prepare("SELECT * FROM queries").all());
  assert.ok(!rows.includes(phone) && !rows.includes("Persona ficticia"));
});

@property --shimmer-angle {
  syntax: "<angle>";
  inherits: true;
  initial-value: 20deg;
}
@property --shimmer-image {
  syntax: "*";
  inherits: false;
}
@property --shimmer-text-fill {
  syntax: "*";
  inherits: false;
}

@theme inline {
  @keyframes tw-shimmer {
    from {
      background-position: 100% 0;
    }
    to {
      background-position: 0 0;
    }
  }
}

@utility shimmer {
  --_spread: var(--shimmer-spread, calc(3ch + 40px));
  --_base: currentColor;
  --_highlight: var(
    --shimmer-color,
    oklch(from currentColor l c h / calc(alpha* 0.2))
  );

  background-image: var(
    --shimmer-image,
    linear-gradient(
      calc(90deg + var(--shimmer-angle)),
      var(--_base) calc(50% - var(--_spread)),
      color-mix(in oklch, var(--_highlight), var(--_base) 50%)
        calc(50% - var(--_spread) * 0.5),
      var(--_highlight) 50%,
      color-mix(in oklch, var(--_highlight), var(--_base) 50%)
        calc(50% + var(--_spread) * 0.5),
      var(--_base) calc(50% + var(--_spread))
    )
  );
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-size: calc(200% + var(--_spread) * 2) 100%;
  background-position: 0 0;
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--shimmer-text-fill, transparent);
  animation: tw-shimmer var(--shimmer-duration, 2s) linear infinite;

  @variant dark {
    --_highlight: var(
      --shimmer-color,
      oklch(from currentColor max(0.8, calc(l + 0.4)) c h / calc(alpha + 0.4))
    );
  }

  &:where([dir="rtl"], [dir="rtl"] *) {
    animation-direction: reverse;
  }
}

===== ARCHIVO: vite.config.ts =====
import vinext from "vinext";
import { defineConfig } from "vite";
import hostingConfig from "./.openai/hosting.json";
import { readExecutionProfile } from "./scripts/execution-profile.mjs";
import { sites } from "./build/sites-vite-plugin";
import { connectorPreview } from "./build/connector-preview-plugin.mjs";

const SITE_CREATOR_PLACEHOLDER_DATABASE_ID =
  "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000";

const { d1, r2 } = hostingConfig;

// macOS Seatbelt blocks FSEvents, so Codex previews need polling for HMR.
const isCodexSeatbeltSandbox = process.env.CODEX_SANDBOX === "seatbelt";
const managedLinux = readExecutionProfile() === "managed-linux";

const localBindingConfig = {
  main: "./build/sites-worker.ts",
  compatibility_flags: ["nodejs_compat"],
  d1_databases: d1
    ? [
        {
          binding: d1,
          database_name: "site-creator-d1",
          database_id: SITE_CREATOR_PLACEHOLDER_DATABASE_ID,
        },
      ]
    : [],
  r2_buckets: r2
    ? [
        {
          binding: r2,
          bucket_name: "site-creator-r2",
        },
      ]
    : [],
};

export default defineConfig(async ({ command }) => {
  // Use Miniflare's local Request.cf placeholder unless fetching is requested.
  process.env.CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED ??= "false";
  process.env.WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS ??= "false";

  // Keep Wrangler and Miniflare state project-local. These are non-secret tool
  // settings; application environment belongs in ignored `.env*` files.
  process.env.WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS ??= "false";
  process.env.WRANGLER_LOG_PATH ??= ".wrangler/logs";
  process.env.WRANGLER_REGISTRY_PATH ??= ".wrangler/dev-registry";
  process.env.MINIFLARE_REGISTRY_PATH ??= ".wrangler/registry";

  // Wrangler snapshots its log path while the Cloudflare plugin is imported.
  const { cloudflare } = await import("@cloudflare/vite-plugin");

  return {
    server: {
      ...(managedLinux
        ? { host: "0.0.0.0", allowedHosts: ["terminal.local"] }
        : {}),
      ...(isCodexSeatbeltSandbox
        ? { watch: { useFsEvents: false, usePolling: true } }
        : {}),
    },
    plugins: [
      vinext(),
      sites({ mockAuth: !managedLinux }),
      connectorPreview(),
      cloudflare({
        viteEnvironment: { name: "rsc", childEnvironments: ["ssr"] },
        inspectorPort: false,
        config: {
          ...localBindingConfig,
          ...(command === "serve"
            ? {
                services: [
                  {
                    binding: "CONNECTORS",
                    service: "sites-connector-preview",
                    entrypoint: "ConnectorPreview",
                  },
                ],
              }
            : {}),
        },
        ...(command === "serve"
          ? {
              auxiliaryWorkers: [
                {
                  config: {
                    name: "sites-connector-preview",
                    main: "./build/connector-preview-worker.mjs",
                    compatibility_date: "2026-05-15",
                  },
                },
              ],
            }
          : {}),
      }),
    ],
  };
});
